title: 街道植栽樹穴海綿設計
summary: 以「街樹根域、雨水與人行空間協調」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow coordinate root volume, stormwater and pedestrian space through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 樹穴集水分區：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 樹穴集水分區 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Tree-pit catchment and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 路緣高度與坡向決定哪一段街道供水；樹冠面積不是集水面積。
steps.instructionEn: Curb height and slopes define the supplying street reach; canopy area is not catchment area.
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: V=C P A;C=0.85;P=0.02;A=150; calculation 0.85*0.02*150 = 2.55 m3. Applicability: Single-storm runoff.
steps.failure: 集水分配不均會一株過濕另一株缺水。
steps.failureEn: Unequal capture can waterlog one tree and dry another.
steps.check: 描繪相鄰兩樹穴集水界線。
steps.checkEn: Map catchment boundaries between adjacent pits.

steps.title: 根域有效土量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effective rooting volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 根域有效土量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effective rooting volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 根可利用的連通土量受基礎、管線與壓實限制；名目開挖體積需扣除障礙。
steps.instructionEn: Connected rooting soil is limited by foundations, utilities and compaction; subtract obstructions from excavation volume.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Vroot=Vgross-Vblocked;12-3；計算 12-3 = 9 m3。適用限制：幾何估計，不是樹種需求值。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Vroot=Vgross-Vblocked;12-3; calculation 12-3 = 9 m3. Applicability: Geometric estimate, not a species-specific requirement.
steps.failure: 把不連通土穴相加會高估可用根域。
steps.failureEn: Adding isolated pockets overstates usable root space.
steps.check: 將地下管線畫入剖面並更新連通土量。
steps.checkEn: Add utilities to the section and update connected soil volume.

stages.title: 異常診斷與改善

steps.title: 結構土與壓實取捨：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Structural soil and compaction trade-offs: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 結構土與壓實取捨 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Structural soil and compaction trade-offs and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 人行承載需要穩定骨架，根域需要孔隙與水氣；兩種要求須共同驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Pavement needs a stable skeleton while roots need pore space and water-air exchange; validate both.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：bulk density=M/V;M=1600 kg;V=1 m3；計算 1600/1 = 1600 kg/m3。適用限制：僅表觀密度，無法單獨判定根域合格。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: bulk density=M/V;M=1600 kg;V=1 m3; calculation 1600/1 = 1600 kg/m3. Applicability: Bulk density alone does not establish rooting suitability.
steps.failure: 只提高壓實度可能損害根系與入滲。
steps.failureEn: Increasing compaction alone can impair roots and infiltration.
steps.check: 同時比較承載試驗與入滲、含氣孔隙。
steps.checkEn: Compare bearing tests with infiltration and air-filled porosity.

steps.title: 鹽分累積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Salt accumulation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 鹽分累積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Salt accumulation and its observable causal relationships.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: V=C P A;C=0.85;P=0.02;A=150; calculation 0.85*0.02*150 = 2.55 m3. Applicability: Single-storm runoff.

title: 社區雨水滲透設施
summary: 以「社區入滲的地層、地下水與事件調蓄」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow stratigraphy, groundwater and event storage for community infiltration through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.failure: 日入滲能力足夠仍可能在短強雨溢流。
steps.failureEn: Adequate daily capacity can still overflow in a short intense storm.
steps.check: 比較同總雨量的短強雨和長弱雨。
steps.checkEn: Compare short intense and long weak storms with equal totals.

scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: effective area=sum(C A);0.9*600+0.3*400; calculation 0.9*600+0.3*400 = 660 m2. Applicability: Teaching estimate with fixed event coefficients.

title: 都市熱島降溫鋪面
titleEn: Cool pavements for urban heat mitigation
summary: 以「鋪面能量收支與行人熱曝露」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow pavement energy balance and pedestrian heat exposure through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.title: 長波放射與天空：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Longwave exchange with the sky: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 長波放射與天空 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Longwave exchange with the sky and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 長波放射依絕對溫度四次方與放射率計算，天空有效溫度亦影響夜間散熱。
steps.instructionEn: Longwave emission depends on the fourth power of absolute temperature and emissivity; effective sky temperature affects night cooling.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：q=epsilon sigma(Ts^4-Tsky^4);eps=0.9;sigma=5.67e-8;Ts=315K;Tsky=290K；計算 0.9*5.67e-8*(315**4-290**4) = 141.496 W/m2。適用限制：以有效天空溫度代表長波環境。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: q=epsilon sigma(Ts^4-Tsky^4);eps=0.9;sigma=5.67e-8;Ts=315K;Tsky=290K; calculation 0.9*5.67e-8*(315**4-290**4) = 141.496 W/m2. Applicability: Effective sky temperature represents the longwave environment.
steps.failure: 以攝氏代入四次方公式會得到錯誤熱通量。
steps.failureEn: Using Celsius in the fourth-power formula gives incorrect flux.

steps.checkEn: Compare sky-view fractions in open and shaded canyons.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：surface contrast=Ts_urban-Ts_reference;48-35；計算 48-35 = 13 K。適用限制：同時同天候表面溫差。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: surface contrast=Ts_urban-Ts_reference;48-35; calculation 48-35 = 13 K. Applicability: Simultaneous surface-temperature contrast under equal weather.

title: 都市風廊與通風模擬
summary: 以「城市幾何、風場邊界與可驗證CFD」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow urban geometry, wind boundaries and verifiable cfd through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 風向與暴露情境：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wind directions and exposure cases: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 風向與暴露情境 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wind directions and exposure cases and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 城市通風需要多風向與代表氣象頻率；單一風向不能代表全年。
steps.instructionEn: Urban ventilation requires multiple directions and representative frequencies; one direction does not represent a year.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：weighted speed=sum(p U);0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5；計算 0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5 = 1.2 m/s。適用限制：假想三風向權重，非風舒適標準。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: weighted speed=sum(p U);0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5; calculation 0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5 = 1.2 m/s. Applicability: Hypothetical three-direction weights, not a comfort standard.
steps.failure: 選有利風向可能掩蓋常見弱通風情境。
steps.failureEn: Choosing a favorable direction hides frequent weak-ventilation cases.
steps.check: 改變風向權重，觀察平均風速與低風區。
steps.checkEn: Change directional weights and examine mean speed and stagnant areas.

steps.title: 污染稀釋與通風：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pollutant dilution and ventilation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染稀釋與通風 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pollutant dilution and ventilation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 較大平均風速不必然降低每一點濃度，污染源位置與回流決定暴露。
steps.instructionEn: Higher average speed does not necessarily lower concentration everywhere; source placement and recirculation govern exposure.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：well-mixed concentration=S/Q;S=20 mg/s;Q=100 m3/s；計算 20/100 = 0.2 mg/m3。適用限制：完全混合箱模型，非街谷CFD結果。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: well-mixed concentration=S/Q;S=20 mg/s;Q=100 m3/s; calculation 20/100 = 0.2 mg/m3. Applicability: Well-mixed box model, not a street-canyon CFD result.
steps.failure: 用箱模型平均濃度代替行人局部峰值會低估曝露。
steps.failureEn: A box average can understate local pedestrian peaks.
steps.check: 移動污染源至背風面，觀察局部濃度差異。
steps.checkEn: Move a source to the leeward side and inspect local concentration.

steps.instruction: 以風洞或現地資料檢查可觀測量並保留模型差異；計算流場不是經校正數位孿生的自動證明。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：weighted speed=sum(p U);0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5；計算 0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5 = 1.2 m/s。適用限制：假想三風向權重，非風舒適標準。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: weighted speed=sum(p U);0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5; calculation 0.5*1+0.3*2+0.2*0.5 = 1.2 m/s. Applicability: Hypothetical three-direction weights, not a comfort standard.

title: 區域冷卻管網
summary: 以「冷量傳輸、壓降與低溫差診斷」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow cooling transfer, pressure loss and low-temperature-difference diagnosis through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 冷量與水流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cooling duty and flow: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 冷量與水流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cooling duty and flow and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 冷量由質量流率、比熱與供回水溫差決定；流量不能獨立代表服務量。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling duty is mass flow times heat capacity and temperature difference; flow alone does not measure service.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K；計算 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW。適用限制：水的定比熱近似。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K; calculation 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW. Applicability: Constant water heat-capacity approximation.
steps.failure: 高流量低溫差可能仍傳送不足冷量。
steps.failureEn: High flow with low temperature difference can still deliver insufficient cooling.
steps.check: 改變溫差並保持流量，觀察冷量。
steps.checkEn: Vary temperature difference at fixed flow and observe duty.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K；計算 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW。適用限制：水的定比熱近似。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K; calculation 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW. Applicability: Constant water heat-capacity approximation.

title: 污水熱回收熱泵
summary: 以「污水熱源、熱泵循環與系統能效」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow wastewater heat sources, heat-pump cycles and system efficiency through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.failure: 用日均流量選設備可能漏掉夜間低流量。
steps.failureEn: Sizing from daily mean flow misses low-flow hours.
steps.check: 疊合24小時熱源和需求曲線。
steps.checkEn: Overlay24-hour source and demand profiles.

steps.failure: 以攝氏計算卡諾COP會失去絕對溫標基礎。
steps.failureEn: Celsius in Carnot COP loses the absolute-temperature basis.
steps.check: 把熱端升高10K，觀察理想上限變化。
steps.checkEn: Raise sink temperature10K and observe the ideal bound.

steps.objective: 區分 溫升與卡諾上限 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Temperature lift and Carnot limit with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 以攝氏計算卡諾COP會失去絕對溫標基礎。
steps.instructionEn: Celsius in Carnot COP loses the absolute-temperature basis.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：COP_Carnot=Th/(Th-Tc);Th=323K;Tc=283K；計算 323/(323-283) = 8.075 ratio。適用限制：可逆理論上限，非設備預測。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: COP_Carnot=Th/(Th-Tc);Th=323K;Tc=283K; calculation 323/(323-283) = 8.075 ratio. Applicability: Reversible upper bound, not equipment prediction.
steps.failure: 以攝氏計算卡諾COP會失去絕對溫標基礎。
steps.failureEn: Celsius in Carnot COP loses the absolute-temperature basis.
steps.check: 把熱端升高10K，觀察理想上限變化。
steps.checkEn: Raise sink temperature10K and observe the ideal bound.

steps.title: 污垢熱阻：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Fouling resistance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污垢熱阻 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fouling resistance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污垢增加熱阻而降低總傳熱係數；壓差與熱阻可能同時變化但不是同一指標。
steps.instructionEn: Fouling adds thermal resistance and lowers U; pressure and thermal resistance may change together but are different measures.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Udirty=1/(1/Uclean+Rf);Uclean=1000;Rf=0.0005；計算 1/(1/1000+0.0005) = 666.667 W/m2/K。適用限制：固定清潔側熱阻。

steps.failure: 只依壓差低就判斷傳熱良好可能漏掉薄污膜。
steps.failureEn: Low pressure loss can miss thermally resistive thin films.
steps.check: 在相同流量比較清洗前後UA及壓差。
steps.checkEn: Compare UA and pressure before/after cleaning at equal flow.

steps.title: 換熱面積量級：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: UA與溫差推動決定換熱量；面積估算需保留污垢與流態假設。
steps.instructionEn: UA and temperature difference set heat transfer; retain fouling and flow assumptions in area estimates.

steps.failureEn: Clean U alone understates operating area needs.
steps.check: 把污垢後U減半，重算面積需求。
steps.checkEn: Halve fouled U and recalculate required area.

steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: DeltaT=Qextract/(m cp);Q=100kW;m=10;cp=4.18; calculation 100/(10*4.18) = 2.39234 K. Applicability: Local cooling without mixing or other heat sources.

steps.failureEn: Fixed extraction at low flow can cause excessive cooling.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：P=E/dt;E=25kWh;dt=0.25h；計算 25/0.25 = 100 kW。適用限制：區間平均，不是瞬時峰值。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: P=E/dt;E=25kWh;dt=0.25h; calculation 25/0.25 = 100 kW. Applicability: Interval mean, not instantaneous peak.

title: 廚餘厭氧消化
summary: 本課以「從廚餘性質、厭氧反應到沼氣與消化液的完整收支」為主軸，依序處理原料驗收與可分解固體、有機體積負荷、水解與反應速率辨識、沼氣能量與輔機邊界、進料中斷與備援重播。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Close the balances from food-waste properties through digestion, biogas and digestate, progressing through Feed acceptance and degradable solids, Organic volumetric loading, Hydrolysis and rate identification, Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary, Feed interruption and backup replay. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 原料驗收與可分解固體：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed acceptance and degradable solids: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 原料驗收與可分解固體 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed acceptance and degradable solids and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先在數位卸料區標出塑膠、骨殼與可分解物；總濕重不能直接作為甲烷產量基準。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: At the digital receiving bay, distinguish plastics, shells and biodegradable material; wet mass is not a direct methane-yield basis. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.

steps.title: 有機體積負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic volumetric loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有機體積負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic volumetric loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把每日進料濃度與泵送量配對，觀察負荷上升是否早於酸累積與產氣變化。 體積負荷描述單位反應體積每天收到的有機質；增加負荷並不保證生物轉換能力同步增加。
steps.instructionEn: Pair feed concentration with daily pumping and examine whether loading increases precede acid accumulation and gas changes. Volumetric loading measures daily organic feed per reactor volume; a larger load does not guarantee a matching biological conversion rate.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 Q=20 m³/d；有機濃度 S=45 kg/m³；反應體積 V=300 m³。公式 OLR=Q*S/V，計算得 3 kg/(m³·d)。適用邊界：S 的基準須註明 COD、VS 或其他成分，不能互換；未納入抑制或溫度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed Q=20 m³/d; organic concentration S=45 kg/m³; reaction volume V=300 m³. Formula OLR=Q*S/V gives 3 kg/(m³·d). Applicability: State whether S is COD, VS or another constituent; these bases are not interchangeable. Inhibition and temperature effects are omitted.
steps.failure: 進料成分突增但流量未變，仍可能造成過負荷。 在「有機體積負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A concentration surge can overload the system even when flow remains unchanged. Mark where this error can enter the Organic volumetric loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「有機體積負荷」，用同一成分分析方法量進料濃度，和有效體積、泵送量作交叉核對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Organic volumetric loading, Measure feed concentration on one analytical basis and cross-check effective volume and pumped quantity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 停留時間與生物量保留：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Residence and biomass retention: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 停留時間與生物量保留 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Residence and biomass retention and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 液體停留與生物量停留可能不同；加入固液分離時，不能只用槽體容積解釋菌群流失。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic and biomass residence may differ; with solids separation, vessel volume alone does not explain biomass washout. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
steps.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「停留時間與生物量保留」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Residence and biomass retention flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「停留時間與生物量保留」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Residence and biomass retention, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 水解與反應速率辨識：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Hydrolysis and rate identification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水解與反應速率辨識 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Hydrolysis and rate identification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用封閉教學批次曲線比較易分解與纖維性廚餘，識別傳質限制與生物反應限制。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: Compare closed teaching-batch curves for readily degradable and fibrous waste to distinguish mass transfer from biological limitations. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「水解與反應速率辨識」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Hydrolysis and rate identification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「水解與反應速率辨識」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Hydrolysis and rate identification, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 揮發性固體與甲烷產率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Volatile solids and methane yield: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 揮發性固體與甲烷產率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Volatile solids and methane yield and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在氣體視窗分開顯示總沼氣與甲烷，並將產量回溯到實際破壞的固體。 甲烷產量依可分解固體與實際轉換產率估算，需區分甲烷體積和含二氧化碳的總沼氣。
steps.instructionEn: Display total biogas separately from methane and relate yield to solids actually destroyed. Methane yield depends on destructible solids and conversion yield; distinguish methane volume from total biogas containing carbon dioxide.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：投入揮發性固體 mVS=500 kg/d；破壞率 r=0.60；假設產率 Y=0.30 m³ CH₄/kg VS destroyed。公式 Q_CH4=mVS*r*Y，計算得 90 m³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Y 是本題假設，不是任何原料保證值；氣體體積需同溫同壓。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Volatile solids feed mVS=500 kg/d; destruction fraction r=0.60; assumed yield Y=0.30 m³ CH₄/kg VS destroyed. Formula Q_CH4=mVS*r*Y gives 90 m³ CH₄/d. Applicability: Y is a teaching assumption, not a guaranteed feedstock value; compare gas volumes at the same temperature and pressure.
steps.failure: 把總沼氣當純甲烷，會高估發電潛力。 在「揮發性固體與甲烷產率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating total biogas as pure methane overstates energy potential. Mark where this error can enter the Volatile solids and methane yield flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「揮發性固體與甲烷產率」，同步記錄進出固體、氣體流量與甲烷比例，做固體與碳收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Volatile solids and methane yield, Record inlet and outlet solids, gas flow and methane fraction together; close solids and carbon balances. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 沼氣能量與輔機邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 沼氣能量與輔機邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將氣體淨化、儲氣和發電串聯；含硫與水分的處理需保留獨立設備與性能證據。 化學能乘轉換效率得到毛發電量，再扣輔助用電才是淨輸出。
steps.instructionEn: Connect gas conditioning, storage and generation; sulfur and moisture removal require distinct equipment and performance evidence. Chemical energy multiplied by conversion efficiency gives gross generation; subtract auxiliary demand for net export.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：甲烷流量 q=90 m³/d；低位熱值 H=35.8 MJ/m³；假設電效率 η=0.32。公式 E=q*H*eta/3.6，計算得 286.4 kWh/d。適用邊界：定常氣質與固定效率；未計停機和輔機，用電效率不能超過 1。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Methane q=90 m³/d; lower heating value H=35.8 MJ/m³; assumed electrical efficiency η=0.32. Formula E=q*H*eta/3.6 gives 286.4 kWh/d. Applicability: Constant gas quality and efficiency; downtime and auxiliaries are omitted and electrical efficiency cannot exceed one.
steps.failure: 把熱效率與電效率相加後套在發電，會重複計算。 在「沼氣能量與輔機邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Applying combined thermal and electrical efficiency to electricity alone double-counts output. Mark where this error can enter the Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「沼氣能量與輔機邊界」，以氣量、甲烷分析及電表對讀，分開列出總發電與輔機耗電。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary, Cross-check gas volume, methane analysis and electric meters; list gross generation and auxiliaries separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 消化液殘餘負荷：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 消化液殘餘負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Residual digestate load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 消化液仍攜帶營養鹽與未轉換有機物；必須追蹤去向，不能將產氣視為所有污染已消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。
steps.instructionEn: Digestate still carries nutrients and unconverted organics; track its destination rather than equating gas production with complete pollutant removal. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
steps.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「消化液殘餘負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Residual digestate load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

steps.objective: 辨識 進料中斷與備援重播 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed interruption and backup replay and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在模擬時間線中重播泵故障，分開記錄停止進料、暫存需求和氣體處理的持續需求。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Replay a feed-pump failure and separately log feed interruption, storage demand and continuing gas-handling needs. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.

steps.title: 物質能量收支驗證：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mass-energy balance verification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 物質能量收支驗證 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mass-energy balance verification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 交付同一時間窗的進料、消化液與氣體清單，找出最影響碳收支閉合的不確定來源。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Deliver feed, digestate and gas inventories over one interval and identify the uncertainty dominating carbon-balance closure. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.

title: 密閉式堆肥反應器
summary: 本課以「密閉堆肥的混料、供氧、散熱與成熟度證據」為主軸，依序處理可堆肥物與雜質驗收、含水率混合設計、需氧與送風分配、蒸發損失與補水、熟化速率與穩定度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Blend, oxygenate, cool and verify maturation in enclosed composting, progressing through Compostable feed and contamination, Moisture blending, Oxygen demand and air distribution, Evaporation and water replacement, Curing rate and stability. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 可堆肥物與雜質驗收：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Compostable feed and contamination: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 可堆肥物與雜質驗收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Compostable feed and contamination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料分選須辨認可分解有機物與不屬於堆肥產品的雜質，粉碎不等於去除污染。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: Receiving inspection separates compostable organics from product contaminants; shredding does not remove contamination. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。

steps.title: 碳氮總量配料：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 碳氮總量配料 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將木質調理料與含氮廚餘逐批分析；總碳氮比需與實際可利用碳一起解讀。 混合碳氮比由碳總質量除以氮總質量；各原料碳氮比的算術平均一般不成立。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze woody bulking material and nitrogen-rich food waste by batch; interpret total C:N alongside available carbon. A blend C:N ratio is total carbon divided by total nitrogen; an arithmetic mean of feedstock ratios is generally invalid.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原料 A：C=30 kg、N=2 kg；原料 B：C=50 kg、N=0.5 kg。公式 C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB)，計算得 32 kg C/kg N。適用邊界：元素總量基準，未區分可生物利用性；數值不是配方建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed A: C=30 kg, N=2 kg; feed B: C=50 kg, N=0.5 kg. Formula C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB) gives 32 kg C/kg N. Applicability: Total elemental basis, without bioavailability; the values are not a recipe recommendation.
steps.failure: 相同總 C:N 仍可能因木質素或抑制物而有不同分解速度。 在「碳氮總量配料」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: The same total C:N can yield different degradation rates because of lignin or inhibitors. Mark where this error can enter the Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「碳氮總量配料」，用原料乾質量與元素分析求 C、N 質量，再檢查混合樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting, Use dry feed mass and elemental analysis to calculate C and N masses, then check the blend. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 含水率混合設計：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture blending: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 含水率混合設計 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture blending and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 濕料提供水分但可能壓縮通氣空間，調理料需求應由水收支與孔隙共同決定。 以水質量守恆求混料量；混合後總重量也改變，所以不能直接相減含水率。
steps.instructionEn: Wet feed supplies moisture but may restrict aeration; select bulking demand from both water balance and porosity. Use water-mass conservation to size a blend; total mass also changes, so subtracting moisture percentages is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕料 m=1000 kg；含水率 w=0.70；調理料含水率 wb=0.20；目標 wt=0.55。公式 m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb)，計算得 428.571 kg。適用邊界：無蒸發、無反應、濕基分率；兩種原料混合，不代表實際最佳堆肥含水率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet feed m=1000 kg; moisture w=0.70; bulking-agent moisture wb=0.20; target wt=0.55. Formula m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb) gives 428.571 kg. Applicability: No evaporation or reaction, wet-basis fractions and two feedstocks; the target is not an operational compost optimum.
steps.failure: 調理料本身很濕，卻仍用乾料假設計算，會低估需要量。 在「含水率混合設計」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating a wet bulking agent as dry underestimates required addition. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture blending flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「含水率混合設計」，對原料與混合樣作同一乾燥法量測，核對預測值與不同位置樣本。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture blending, Measure both feeds and blend by the same drying method; compare prediction with spatial subsamples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 填料孔隙與壓實：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Bed porosity and compaction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 填料孔隙與壓實 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Bed porosity and compaction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在反應器剖面觀察壓實層；相同風量下，不同堆積狀態產生不同氧分布。 空氣孔隙是總體積扣除固體和水；總孔隙高不代表可供氣體通過的連通孔隙高。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect compacted layers in a reactor section; equal air supply gives different oxygen distributions for different packing. Air-filled porosity is bulk volume less solids and water; high total porosity does not ensure connected gas pathways.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：堆體體積 V=10 m³；固體體積 Vs=3.0 m³；液體體積 Vw=2.5 m³。公式 air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V，計算得 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk。適用邊界：體積可加的簡化；未計壓縮、粒徑分布與連通性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=10 m³; solid volume Vs=3.0 m³; water volume Vw=2.5 m³. Formula air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V gives 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk. Applicability: Additive-volume approximation without compression, particle-size distribution or connectivity.
steps.failure: 過度壓實或積水會關閉氣道，讓平均送風量失去代表性。 在「填料孔隙與壓實」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Compaction or waterlogging closes gas paths, making mean airflow unrepresentative. Mark where this error can enter the Bed porosity and compaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「填料孔隙與壓實」，測堆積密度、含水量和壓降，分辨孔隙不足與氣流短路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Bed porosity and compaction, Measure bulk density, moisture and pressure drop to distinguish insufficient porosity from gas bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 需氧與送風分配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Oxygen demand and air distribution: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 需氧與送風分配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen demand and air distribution and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把微生物需氧量與送風網路連結，利用區域讀值尋找缺氧口袋。 所需空氣量受到氧含量和有效利用率限制；供氣量不是微生物實際吸收氧量。
steps.instructionEn: Link microbial oxygen demand to the air network and use zone readings to locate oxygen-depleted pockets. Air demand depends on oxygen fraction and effective utilization; supplied air is not the oxygen actually consumed by microbes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氧需求 D=12 kg O₂/h；空氣氧質量分率 x=0.232；假設利用率 η=0.35。公式 m_air=D/(x*eta)，計算得 147.783 kg air/h。適用邊界：以氧質量收支近似，不是送風機操作設定；未計熱量與水分控制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Oxygen demand D=12 kg O₂/h; oxygen mass fraction in air x=0.232; assumed utilization η=0.35. Formula m_air=D/(x*eta) gives 147.783 kg air/h. Applicability: An oxygen mass-balance approximation, not a blower setting; heat and moisture control are excluded.
steps.failure: 旁通氣流增加時總送風上升，但反應區仍可能缺氧。 在「需氧與送風分配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Increasing bypass airflow can raise total supply while reactive zones remain oxygen-limited. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen demand and air distribution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「需氧與送風分配」，在進出口量氧濃度與流量，觀察不同位置氧剖面而非只讀總管。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Oxygen demand and air distribution, Measure inlet and outlet oxygen and flow; inspect spatial oxygen profiles rather than only the main header. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 η 改成 0.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 147.783 變成 206.897 kg air/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only η to 0.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 147.783 to 206.897 kg air/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 蒸發損失與補水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Evaporation and water replacement: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 蒸發損失與補水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Evaporation and water replacement and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將濕度與質量減少對照，區分蒸發造成的乾燥和生物分解造成的有機物減少。 相變將熱轉為水蒸氣焓；潮濕材料處理中，蒸發可能比顯熱更耗能。
steps.instructionEn: Compare humidity with weight loss to distinguish evaporation-driven drying from biological organic-matter loss. Phase change transfers heat into water-vapour enthalpy; evaporation can dominate sensible heating in wet-material processing.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸發水量 m=100 kg/h；假設潛熱 hfg=2257 kJ/kg。公式 P=m*hfg/3600，計算得 62.6944 kW。適用邊界：潛熱值只代表近常壓沸點示例，不模擬其他溫壓下的完整乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Evaporated water m=100 kg/h; assumed latent heat hfg=2257 kJ/kg. Formula P=m*hfg/3600 gives 62.6944 kW. Applicability: The latent heat represents a near-atmospheric boiling example, not full drying at other conditions.
steps.failure: 把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「蒸發損失與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and water replacement flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「蒸發損失與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Evaporation and water replacement, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 批次停留與短流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Batch residence and short-circuiting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 批次停留與短流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Batch residence and short-circuiting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 連續進料設備須追蹤物料停留分布；平均時間不能證明每份物料都經歷相同條件。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。
steps.instructionEn: Continuous reactors need material residence distributions; a mean duration does not prove identical histories for every portion. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
steps.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「批次停留與短流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Batch residence and short-circuiting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「批次停留與短流」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Batch residence and short-circuiting, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 熟化速率與穩定度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Curing rate and stability: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 熟化速率與穩定度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Curing rate and stability and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 熟化曲線需配合呼吸活性與再升溫觀察；一次低溫讀值可能只是乾燥或缺氧。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: Interpret curing curves with respiration and reheating observations; one low-temperature reading may reflect dryness or oxygen shortage. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「熟化速率與穩定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Curing rate and stability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「熟化速率與穩定度」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Curing rate and stability, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 完成 熟化速率與穩定度 的量測或模型練習，記錄與假設的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Curing rate and stability and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
針對「熟化速率與穩定度」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
操作任務：只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
steps.instructionEn:
For Curing rate and stability, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
Action: Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「熟化速率與穩定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Curing rate and stability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

steps.title: 密閉系統與故障交接：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Enclosure failure and handoff: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 密閉系統與故障交接 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Enclosure failure and handoff and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重播風機停機與排氣處理失效，在教學儀表上記錄可用時間和產品批次隔離。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Replay fan or exhaust-treatment failure and document availability and affected batch segregation in the teaching interface. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
steps.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「密閉系統與故障交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Enclosure failure and handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「密閉系統與故障交接」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Enclosure failure and handoff, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

optionsEn: Replay fan or exhaust-treatment failure and document availability and affected batch segregation in the teaching interface.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.

title: 條垛堆肥通風控制
summary: 本課以「用空間氧氣、水分與溫度資料調整條垛堆肥通風」為主軸，依序處理條垛原料碳氮分層、翻堆與可通氣孔隙、強制通風能耗、冬夏顯熱交換、露天雨水與滲出水收支。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Use spatial oxygen, moisture and temperature evidence to assess windrow aeration, progressing through Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity, Turning and aeratable porosity, Forced-aeration energy, Seasonal sensible-heat exchange, Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 條垛原料碳氮分層：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 條垛原料碳氮分層 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 條垛不是均質容器，混料紀錄應保留各區原料比例，避免平均比值掩蓋局部差異。 混合碳氮比由碳總質量除以氮總質量；各原料碳氮比的算術平均一般不成立。
steps.instructionEn: A windrow is not a homogeneous vessel; retain local blend records so averages do not conceal heterogeneity. A blend C:N ratio is total carbon divided by total nitrogen; an arithmetic mean of feedstock ratios is generally invalid.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原料 A：C=30 kg、N=2 kg；原料 B：C=50 kg、N=0.5 kg。公式 C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB)，計算得 32 kg C/kg N。適用邊界：元素總量基準，未區分可生物利用性；數值不是配方建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed A: C=30 kg, N=2 kg; feed B: C=50 kg, N=0.5 kg. Formula C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB) gives 32 kg C/kg N. Applicability: Total elemental basis, without bioavailability; the values are not a recipe recommendation.
steps.failure: 相同總 C:N 仍可能因木質素或抑制物而有不同分解速度。 在「條垛原料碳氮分層」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: The same total C:N can yield different degradation rates because of lignin or inhibitors. Mark where this error can enter the Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「條垛原料碳氮分層」，用原料乾質量與元素分析求 C、N 質量，再檢查混合樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity, Use dry feed mass and elemental analysis to calculate C and N masses, then check the blend. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.titleEn: Moisture after rainfall: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨後含水調整 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture after rainfall and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 雨水可增加表層含水，核心仍可能偏乾；採樣位置需隨深度記錄。 以水質量守恆求混料量；混合後總重量也改變，所以不能直接相減含水率。
steps.instructionEn: Rain wets surface layers while cores may remain dry; record sampling depth and position. Use water-mass conservation to size a blend; total mass also changes, so subtracting moisture percentages is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕料 m=1000 kg；含水率 w=0.70；調理料含水率 wb=0.20；目標 wt=0.55。公式 m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb)，計算得 428.571 kg。適用邊界：無蒸發、無反應、濕基分率；兩種原料混合，不代表實際最佳堆肥含水率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet feed m=1000 kg; moisture w=0.70; bulking-agent moisture wb=0.20; target wt=0.55. Formula m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb) gives 428.571 kg. Applicability: No evaporation or reaction, wet-basis fractions and two feedstocks; the target is not an operational compost optimum.
steps.failure: 調理料本身很濕，卻仍用乾料假設計算，會低估需要量。 在「雨後含水調整」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating a wet bulking agent as dry underestimates required addition. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture after rainfall flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「雨後含水調整」，對原料與混合樣作同一乾燥法量測，核對預測值與不同位置樣本。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture after rainfall, Measure both feeds and blend by the same drying method; compare prediction with spatial subsamples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 翻堆與可通氣孔隙：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Turning and aeratable porosity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 翻堆與可通氣孔隙 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Turning and aeratable porosity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 翻堆會重新配置顆粒與孔隙，改善暫時配流但不能代替後續氧氣監測。 空氣孔隙是總體積扣除固體和水；總孔隙高不代表可供氣體通過的連通孔隙高。
steps.instructionEn: Turning rearranges particles and pores, temporarily improving distribution without replacing subsequent oxygen monitoring. Air-filled porosity is bulk volume less solids and water; high total porosity does not ensure connected gas pathways.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：堆體體積 V=10 m³；固體體積 Vs=3.0 m³；液體體積 Vw=2.5 m³。公式 air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V，計算得 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk。適用邊界：體積可加的簡化；未計壓縮、粒徑分布與連通性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=10 m³; solid volume Vs=3.0 m³; water volume Vw=2.5 m³. Formula air_fraction=(V-Vs-Vw)/V gives 0.45 m³ air/m³ bulk. Applicability: Additive-volume approximation without compression, particle-size distribution or connectivity.
steps.failure: 過度壓實或積水會關閉氣道，讓平均送風量失去代表性。 在「翻堆與可通氣孔隙」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Compaction or waterlogging closes gas paths, making mean airflow unrepresentative. Mark where this error can enter the Turning and aeratable porosity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「翻堆與可通氣孔隙」，測堆積密度、含水量和壓降，分辨孔隙不足與氣流短路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Turning and aeratable porosity, Measure bulk density, moisture and pressure drop to distinguish insufficient porosity from gas bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.titleEn: Oxygen estimation and zoned air: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 需氧估計與區域供氣 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen estimation and zoned air and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較表層、核心與底部的氧濃度，辨認供氣量不足和氣流繞行兩種原因。 所需空氣量受到氧含量和有效利用率限制；供氣量不是微生物實際吸收氧量。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface, core and base oxygen to distinguish insufficient supply from bypass flow. Air demand depends on oxygen fraction and effective utilization; supplied air is not the oxygen actually consumed by microbes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氧需求 D=12 kg O₂/h；空氣氧質量分率 x=0.232；假設利用率 η=0.35。公式 m_air=D/(x*eta)，計算得 147.783 kg air/h。適用邊界：以氧質量收支近似，不是送風機操作設定；未計熱量與水分控制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Oxygen demand D=12 kg O₂/h; oxygen mass fraction in air x=0.232; assumed utilization η=0.35. Formula m_air=D/(x*eta) gives 147.783 kg air/h. Applicability: An oxygen mass-balance approximation, not a blower setting; heat and moisture control are excluded.
steps.failure: 旁通氣流增加時總送風上升，但反應區仍可能缺氧。 在「需氧估計與區域供氣」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Increasing bypass airflow can raise total supply while reactive zones remain oxygen-limited. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen estimation and zoned air flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「需氧估計與區域供氣」，在進出口量氧濃度與流量，觀察不同位置氧剖面而非只讀總管。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Oxygen estimation and zoned air, Measure inlet and outlet oxygen and flow; inspect spatial oxygen profiles rather than only the main header. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Compare surface, core and base oxygen to distinguish insufficient supply from bypass flow. Air demand depends on oxygen fraction and effective utilization; supplied air is not the oxygen actually consumed by microbes.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 η 改成 0.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 147.783 變成 206.897 kg air/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only η to 0.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 147.783 to 206.897 kg air/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 強制通風能耗：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Forced-aeration energy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 強制通風能耗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Forced-aeration energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 調整送風時同時看風機功率和氧氣分布，避免把高電耗當成高處理能力。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: When changing aeration, examine both fan power and oxygen distribution rather than equating power with treatment capacity. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
steps.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「強制通風能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Forced-aeration energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「強制通風能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Forced-aeration energy, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 在主管與分支量差壓，分辨管路堵塞和堆體局部壓實。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。

steps.title: 冬夏顯熱交換：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Seasonal sensible-heat exchange: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 冬夏顯熱交換 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Seasonal sensible-heat exchange and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 相同送風量在不同氣溫下有不同冷卻能力，通風策略需保留氣象條件。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。
steps.instructionEn: Equal airflow has different cooling effects at different ambient temperatures, so retain meteorological conditions. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
steps.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「冬夏顯熱交換」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Seasonal sensible-heat exchange flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「冬夏顯熱交換」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Seasonal sensible-heat exchange, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 通風乾燥與蒸發：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ventilation drying and evaporation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 通風乾燥與蒸發 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ventilation drying and evaporation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 高風量可能快速帶走水分而抑制反應，不能只以溫度下降當成改善。 相變將熱轉為水蒸氣焓；潮濕材料處理中，蒸發可能比顯熱更耗能。
steps.instructionEn: High airflow can remove moisture and inhibit activity; cooling alone is not evidence of improvement. Phase change transfers heat into water-vapour enthalpy; evaporation can dominate sensible heating in wet-material processing.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸發水量 m=100 kg/h；假設潛熱 hfg=2257 kJ/kg。公式 P=m*hfg/3600，計算得 62.6944 kW。適用邊界：潛熱值只代表近常壓沸點示例，不模擬其他溫壓下的完整乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Evaporated water m=100 kg/h; assumed latent heat hfg=2257 kJ/kg. Formula P=m*hfg/3600 gives 62.6944 kW. Applicability: The latent heat represents a near-atmospheric boiling example, not full drying at other conditions.
steps.failure: 把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「通風乾燥與蒸發」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Ventilation drying and evaporation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「通風乾燥與蒸發」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Ventilation drying and evaporation, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 m 改成 130 kg/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 62.6944 變成 81.5028 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only m to 130 kg/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 62.6944 to 81.5028 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 露天雨水與滲出水收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 露天雨水與滲出水收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把條垛場地逕流、蓄水與滲出液分開，避免雨量直接轉成污染水量。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。
steps.instructionEn: Separate runoff, storage and leachate across the windrow pad instead of converting all rainfall directly into contaminated drainage. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
steps.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「露天雨水與滲出水收支」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「露天雨水與滲出水收支」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

summary: 本課以「以熱量、料床停留與排放證據理解爐排燃燒控制」為主軸，依序處理垃圾熱值與負荷邊界、爐排速度與物料停留、煙氣污染質量通量、整合煙氣處理績效、毛發電與淨效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Understand grate combustion through heat input, bed residence and emission evidence, progressing through Waste heating value and load boundary, Grate motion and material residence, Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Gross generation and net benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 垃圾熱值與負荷邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Waste heating value and load boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾熱值與負荷邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Waste heating value and load boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將濕基進料、含水率及熱值連結，從源頭解釋蒸汽與煙氣波動。 燃料熱輸入由濕基進料量與對應低位熱值決定；相同噸數可能帶入不同熱量。
steps.instructionEn: Link wet feed, moisture and heating value to explain steam and flue-gas fluctuations at the source. Fuel heat input is wet feed multiplied by its corresponding lower heating value; equal tonnage can carry different heat input.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.
steps.failure: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mass-flow control alone misses heat-load changes caused by moisture and heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Waste heating value and load boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」，依代表性分樣求含水與熱值，和料重、蒸汽負荷及未燃分交叉檢查。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Waste heating value and load boundary, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 一次與二次空氣的功能：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary and secondary air roles: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 一次與二次空氣的功能 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary and secondary air roles and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 一次空氣穿過料床，二次空氣協助氣相混合；總量與分配必須分開評估。 實際空氣量為理論空氣量乘過量係數；更多空氣也增加煙氣及熱損失。
steps.instructionEn: Primary air passes through the bed while secondary air supports gas mixing; assess totals separately from distribution. Actual air is stoichiometric air times the excess-air ratio; more air also increases flue-gas flow and heat loss.

steps.title: 爐排速度與物料停留：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Grate motion and material residence: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 爐排速度與物料停留 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Grate motion and material residence and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以動畫追蹤乾燥、燃燒與燃盡區，料床厚度和滑移會改變實際停留。 移動料床的名目停留時間取決於路徑與速度；翻動和滑移使個別顆粒不同。
steps.instructionEn: Track drying, combustion and burnout zones in animation; bed depth and slip alter actual residence. Nominal moving-bed residence depends on path and speed; mixing and slip give particles different histories.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效路徑 L=6 m；平均移動速度 v=0.10 m/min。公式 t=L/v，計算得 60 min。適用邊界：一維平均速度近似，不代表燃盡、熟化或實際設備速度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective path L=6 m; mean travel speed v=0.10 m/min. Formula t=L/v gives 60 min. Applicability: One-dimensional mean-speed approximation; it does not establish burnout, maturity or an equipment setting.
steps.failure: 用機構速度代替物料速度，可能低估回混與滯留。 在「爐排速度與物料停留」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using mechanism speed as material speed can miss back-mixing and hold-up. Mark where this error can enter the Grate motion and material residence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「爐排速度與物料停留」，以標記粒子或數位重播比較前緣與尾端到達時間，記錄速度分布。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Grate motion and material residence, Use marked particles or digital replay to compare leading and trailing arrival times and record speed spread. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 含水進料的熱需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Heating demand of wet feed: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 含水進料的熱需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Heating demand of wet feed and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 高含水垃圾先消耗熱量升溫，並增加後續蒸發負荷，不能直接視為有效燃料。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。
steps.instructionEn: Wet waste first absorbs sensible heat and adds evaporation demand; it is not all useful fuel. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
steps.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「含水進料的熱需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Heating demand of wet feed flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「含水進料的熱需求」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Heating demand of wet feed, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 煙氣污染質量通量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flue-gas pollutant mass rate: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙氣污染質量通量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flue-gas pollutant mass rate and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將濃度與同基準氣量組合，辨認稀釋變化和真正污染負荷變化。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Combine concentration with matched gas flow to distinguish dilution from pollutant-load changes. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「煙氣污染質量通量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Flue-gas pollutant mass rate flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「煙氣污染質量通量」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 氧校正與比較基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Oxygen normalization and comparison: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氧校正與比較基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen normalization and comparison and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在數位報表分開顯示原始與校正濃度，避免配風改變引起的表面改善。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。
steps.instructionEn: Show raw and normalized concentrations separately to avoid apparent improvement caused only by airflow changes. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
steps.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「氧校正與比較基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen normalization and comparison flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「氧校正與比較基準」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Oxygen normalization and comparison, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 整合煙氣處理績效：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Integrated flue-gas treatment performance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 整合煙氣處理績效 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Integrated flue-gas treatment performance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 燃燒與末端防制共同影響出口，需比較入口負荷、出口濃度與殘渣去向。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。
steps.instructionEn: Combustion and downstream control jointly determine discharge; compare inlet loads, outlet levels and residue destinations. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
steps.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「整合煙氣處理績效」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Integrated flue-gas treatment performance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「整合煙氣處理績效」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 毛發電與淨效益：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gross generation and net benefit: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 毛發電與淨效益 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gross generation and net benefit and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 燃燒最佳化須連同引風、送風與加藥輔機用電評估，不能只最大化蒸汽量。 淨輸出必須扣除系統內輔機；邊界決定哪些用電應納入。
steps.instructionEn: Evaluate combustion together with draft, air and dosing auxiliaries rather than maximizing steam alone. Net output subtracts internal auxiliaries; the chosen system boundary determines which loads belong in the account.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：毛發電 Eg=1200 kWh/d；風機 Ef=160 kWh/d；泵 Ep=90 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep，計算得 950 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一日與同一電表邊界，未計外購熱和建造能耗。

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.

title: 焚化餘熱鍋爐整合
summary: 本課以「連結焚化熱輸入、傳熱阻力與蒸汽循環的能量平衡」為主軸，依序處理焚化熱輸入基準、給水與蒸汽焓差、煙側差壓與堵塞診斷、循環泵與給水輔機、量測誤差與能量閉合。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect incinerator heat input, thermal resistance and the steam cycle, progressing through Incineration heat-input basis, Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise, Gas-side pressure drop and blockage, Circulation and feedwater auxiliaries, Measurement error and energy closure. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 焚化熱輸入基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Incineration heat-input basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 焚化熱輸入基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Incineration heat-input basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先固定濕基低位熱值與進料時間窗，再討論鍋爐的熱回收比例。 燃料熱輸入由濕基進料量與對應低位熱值決定；相同噸數可能帶入不同熱量。
steps.instructionEn: Fix wet-basis lower heating value and feed interval before discussing boiler heat recovery. Fuel heat input is wet feed multiplied by its corresponding lower heating value; equal tonnage can carry different heat input.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。

steps.failure: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「焚化熱輸入基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.checkEn: For Incineration heat-input basis, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 煙氣顯熱曲線：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flue-gas sensible-heat curve: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙氣顯熱曲線 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flue-gas sensible-heat curve and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用各受熱面前後溫度建立能量梯度，辨認熱量移除的主要區段。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。
steps.instructionEn: Use temperatures across heating surfaces to map energy gradients and identify major heat-removal sections. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
steps.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「煙氣顯熱曲線」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Flue-gas sensible-heat curve flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「煙氣顯熱曲線」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Flue-gas sensible-heat curve, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
