steps.title: 給水與蒸汽焓差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 給水與蒸汽焓差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 過熱、汽化與給水加熱需以焓統一計算，不能只比溫度。 蒸汽產率由熱功率除以比焓提升；壓力、溫度和給水狀態都影響焓差。
steps.instructionEn: Unify superheating, vaporization and feedwater heating through enthalpy rather than temperature alone. Steam rate is heat duty divided by specific enthalpy rise; pressure, temperature and feedwater condition determine that rise.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效熱功率 P=5 MW；給水至蒸汽比焓差 Δh=2500 kJ/kg。公式 msteam=P*1000/dh，計算得 2 kg/s。適用邊界：Δh 為假想狀態表輸入，忽略排污與熱損失；不是鍋爐操作條件。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Useful heat P=5 MW; feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise Δh=2500 kJ/kg. Formula msteam=P*1000/dh gives 2 kg/s. Applicability: Δh is a hypothetical property-table input; blowdown and losses are omitted and no boiler operating condition is specified.
steps.failure: 只用溫差估蒸汽生成會漏掉汽化潛熱。 在「給水與蒸汽焓差」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Temperature difference alone misses vaporization enthalpy in steam generation. Mark where this error can enter the Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「給水與蒸汽焓差」，從同一熱力狀態表記錄入口出口焓，再核對蒸汽流量與熱輸入。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise, Record inlet and outlet enthalpies from one property basis and cross-check steam flow and heat input. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 給水與蒸汽焓差

knowledge.textEn: Unify superheating, vaporization and feedwater heating through enthalpy rather than temperature alone. Steam rate is heat duty divided by specific enthalpy rise; pressure, temperature and feedwater condition determine that rise.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 Δh 改成 2700 kJ/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1.85185 kg/s。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Δh to 2700 kJ/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1.85185 kg/s. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 積灰造成的總熱阻：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Overall resistance from deposits: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 積灰造成的總熱阻 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Overall resistance from deposits and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較清潔與積灰工況的有效傳熱係數，並將煙氣溫度變化與熱值變動分開。 傳熱能力由總熱阻與面積控制，積灰增加熱阻而降低有效 U。
steps.instructionEn: Compare effective coefficients for clean and fouled conditions, separating gas-temperature changes from fuel variations. Heat transfer depends on overall thermal resistance and area; deposits add resistance and reduce effective U.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：傳熱係數 U=40 W/(m²·K)；面積 A=200 m²；假設平均溫差 ΔT=150 K。公式 P=U*A*dT/1000，計算得 1200 kW。適用邊界：給定平均溫差、固定物性，不解局部熱點與腐蝕。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heat-transfer coefficient U=40 W/(m²·K); area A=200 m²; assumed mean driving temperature ΔT=150 K. Formula P=U*A*dT/1000 gives 1200 kW. Applicability: Specified mean temperature driving force and fixed properties; local hot spots and corrosion are not resolved.
steps.failure: 煙溫升高可能來自傳熱面積灰，而不一定是熱值增加。 在「積灰造成的總熱阻」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Higher flue temperature can indicate fouling rather than higher fuel heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Overall resistance from deposits flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「積灰造成的總熱阻」，用熱側與冷側能量收支反推 U，對照積灰前後差壓及熱像。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Overall resistance from deposits, Infer U from hot- and cold-side balances and compare pressure drop and thermal images before and after fouling. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 煙側差壓與堵塞診斷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gas-side pressure drop and blockage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙側差壓與堵塞診斷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gas-side pressure drop and blockage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 熱傳下降與差壓上升同時出現，較能支持積灰假說；單一訊號不足以確診。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Concurrent heat-transfer decline and pressure-drop rise better support fouling than either signal alone. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
steps.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「煙側差壓與堵塞診斷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Gas-side pressure drop and blockage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「煙側差壓與堵塞診斷」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Gas-side pressure drop and blockage, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 把泵送揚程與流量連回循環需求，避免淨發電評估遺漏輔機。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。
steps.instructionEn: Relate pumping head and flow to cycle demand so net-generation assessment includes auxiliaries. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.

steps.title: 量測誤差與能量閉合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Measurement error and energy closure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 量測誤差與能量閉合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Measurement error and energy closure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同時核對燃料熱輸入、蒸汽流量和焓差，找出能量殘差是否超過量測不確定度。 熱功率 P=mdot*Δh；獨立小誤差時，相對方差近似相加，焓差需由壓力、溫度與狀態資料求得。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile fuel heat, steam flow and enthalpy rise and test whether the residual exceeds measurement uncertainty. Thermal power P=mdot*Δh; relative variances approximately add for independent small errors, and enthalpy rise requires pressure, temperature and state data.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸汽質量流率相對標準不確定度 um=0.04；比焓差相對標準不確定度 uh=0.06。公式 uP=sqrt(um²+uh²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty of thermal power。適用邊界：質量流率和焓差相互獨立的一階傳播；若共享感測器或校正則需共變異，不是完整鍋爐效率不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Relative standard uncertainty in steam mass flow um=0.04 and specific-enthalpy rise uh=0.06. Formula uP=sqrt(um²+uh²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty of thermal power. Applicability: First-order propagation for independent mass flow and enthalpy rise; shared sensors or calibration require covariance, and this is not total boiler-efficiency uncertainty.
steps.failure: 忽略濕蒸汽狀態或把總焓當焓差會形成系統偏差，重複量測不會自動消除。 在「量測誤差與能量閉合」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring wet-steam state or substituting absolute enthalpy for enthalpy rise creates systematic bias that repetitions do not remove. Mark where this error can enter the Measurement error and energy closure flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「量測誤差與能量閉合」，把流量計、壓溫感測與蒸汽表狀態模型的不確定來源分開，核對時間窗與焓基準。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Measurement error and energy closure, Separate uncertainty from flowmeter, pressure/temperature sensors and steam-state model and check time windows and enthalpy reference. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.

title: 焚化底渣金屬回收
titleEn: Metal recovery from incinerator bottom ash
summary: 本課以「以粒徑、解離度和品位回收率設計底渣金屬分選的教學流程」為主軸，依序處理底渣批次與金屬基準、鐵磁性金屬回收、含水與細泥附著、礦物產物浸出評估、分選用電與資源效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Build a bottom-ash metal-separation workflow around size, liberation and grade-recovery evidence, progressing through Bottom-ash batches and metal basis, Ferromagnetic metal recovery, Moisture and adhering fines, Leaching of mineral products, Separation electricity and resource benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 底渣批次與金屬基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Bottom-ash batches and metal basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 底渣批次與金屬基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Bottom-ash batches and metal basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先確認底渣來源與乾濕基，區分爐底渣、飛灰和其他混入物流。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the bottom-ash source and moisture basis, distinguishing it from fly ash and other mixed streams. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
steps.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「底渣批次與金屬基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Bottom-ash batches and metal basis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「底渣批次與金屬基準」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Bottom-ash batches and metal basis, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 粒徑分級與篩分：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Size classes and screening: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 粒徑分級與篩分 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Size classes and screening and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 不同粒徑的解離程度和適用分選機不同，先分級再比較效率。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。
steps.instructionEn: Particle sizes differ in liberation and suitable separators; classify before comparing performance. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；細粒比例 f=0.30；細粒捕集率 r=0.90。公式 mf=m*f*r，計算得 270 kg。適用邊界：只算細粒回收，不含粗粒誤入及顆粒團聚。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; fines fraction f=0.30; fines capture r=0.90. Formula mf=m*f*r gives 270 kg. Applicability: Fines recovery only; coarse misplacement and agglomeration are omitted.
steps.failure: 濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「粒徑分級與篩分」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Size classes and screening flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「粒徑分級與篩分」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Size classes and screening, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Change only capture r to 0.70, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 270 to 210 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

steps.title: 鐵磁性金屬回收：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ferromagnetic metal recovery: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 鐵磁性金屬回收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ferromagnetic metal recovery and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 磁選以鐵磁性響應分離，夾附礦物和纏繞金屬會改變產品重量。 回收率衡量原料目標物有多少進入產品；純度則看產品中有多少是目標物，兩者不同。
steps.instructionEn: Magnetic separation uses ferromagnetic response; adhering minerals and tangled metal change product mass. Recovery measures how much feed target reaches product; purity measures target fraction within product. They differ.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；目標金屬分率 x=0.08；分選回收率 r=0.75。公式 m_metal=m*x*r，計算得 60 kg。適用邊界：已知原料成分、單一分選步驟；未計附著物或後續精製。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; target metal fraction x=0.08; separation recovery r=0.75. Formula m_metal=m*x*r gives 60 kg. Applicability: Known feed composition and one separator; adhering material and downstream refining are excluded.
steps.failure: 提高產品總重量可能只是混入更多非金屬。 在「鐵磁性金屬回收」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A heavier product may merely contain more non-metal contamination. Mark where this error can enter the Ferromagnetic metal recovery flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「鐵磁性金屬回收」，對進料、產品及尾料分別秤重化驗，求回收率與純度並關閉金屬收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Ferromagnetic metal recovery, Weigh and assay feed, product and tailings; calculate recovery and purity and close the metal balance. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 表面水與細泥增加黏附，影響篩分和金屬品位；乾濕處理流程需用同基準比較。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。
steps.instructionEn: Surface water and fines promote adhesion, affecting screening and grade; compare wet and dry routes on consistent bases. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. steps.instruction: 粗粒回收率高仍可能漏掉細粒金屬，應為每個粒級建立獨立收支。 回收率衡量原料目標物有多少進入產品；純度則看產品中有多少是目標物，兩者不同。
steps.instructionEn: High coarse recovery may hide fine-metal losses; construct separate balances by size class. Recovery measures how much feed target reaches product; purity measures target fraction within product. They differ.

steps.title: 礦物產物浸出評估：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Leaching of mineral products: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 礦物產物浸出評估 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Leaching of mineral products and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 金屬回收後的礦物料仍需確認環境適用性；外觀乾淨不是浸出證據。 浸出質量可由液體濃度和體積換算，但不能把此值當成樣品總含量。
steps.instructionEn: The mineral fraction still needs environmental suitability assessment; clean appearance is not leaching evidence. Released mass follows liquid concentration and volume, but is not the specimen total content.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：浸出液濃度 C=2 mg/L；液體體積 V=2 L；試樣乾質量 m=0.10 kg。公式 released=C*V/m，計算得 40 mg/kg dry sample。適用邊界：以單次均勻浸出作教學換算；不同方法的液固比、pH 和時間不可混用。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Leachate concentration C=2 mg/L; liquid volume V=2 L; dry specimen m=0.10 kg. Formula released=C*V/m gives 40 mg/kg dry sample. Applicability: A single homogeneous extraction for teaching conversion; do not mix liquid/solid ratios, pH or duration across methods.
steps.failure: 浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「礦物產物浸出評估」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Leaching of mineral products flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「礦物產物浸出評估」，記錄方法、空白、液固比和乾重，將浸出 mg/L 與換算 mg/kg 分欄呈現。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Leaching of mineral products, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 粉塵捕集與外逸：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dust collection and escape: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 粉塵捕集與外逸 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dust collection and escape and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 乾式分選的粉塵負荷應沿各轉運點追蹤，末端濃度要連同氣量解讀。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Track dry-separation dust at transfer points and interpret outlet concentrations with gas flow. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「粉塵捕集與外逸」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Dust collection and escape flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「粉塵捕集與外逸」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Dust collection and escape, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

title: 焚化飛灰穩定化
summary: 本課以「分辨飛灰污染總量、固定化效能與長期浸出證據」為主軸，依序處理飛灰與防制殘渣界定、乾基添加量、固定介質容量概念、洗液與污染轉移、穩定化能耗比較。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Distinguish fly-ash inventory, immobilization performance and long-term leaching evidence, progressing through Fly ash and control-residue identification, Dry-basis amendment quantity, Immobilizing-media capacity, Wash water and contaminant transfer, Stabilization energy comparison. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 飛灰與防制殘渣界定：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Fly ash and control-residue identification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 飛灰與防制殘渣界定 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fly ash and control-residue identification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 不同捕集點產生不同鹽分、金屬和碳含量，混樣前必須保留來源。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: Different collection points yield different salts, metals and carbon; preserve provenance before compositing. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
steps.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「飛灰與防制殘渣界定」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Fly ash and control-residue identification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「飛灰與防制殘渣界定」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Fly ash and control-residue identification, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 辨識 粒徑與均質分樣 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Particle size and representative splitting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 細粒與團聚物可能分層，取樣和縮分須避免只取得表面鬆散粉體。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。
steps.instructionEn: Fines and agglomerates can segregate; sampling and splitting must avoid selecting only loose surface powder. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；細粒比例 f=0.30；細粒捕集率 r=0.90。公式 mf=m*f*r，計算得 270 kg。適用邊界：只算細粒回收，不含粗粒誤入及顆粒團聚。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; fines fraction f=0.30; fines capture r=0.90. Formula mf=m*f*r gives 270 kg. Applicability: Fines recovery only; coarse misplacement and agglomeration are omitted.
steps.failure: 濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「粒徑與均質分樣」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Particle size and representative splitting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「粒徑與均質分樣」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Particle size and representative splitting, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 辨識 乾基添加量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dry-basis amendment quantity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 固定化與固化不是同一機制，添加物需按乾基記帳並經獨立試驗選擇。 劑量需指明相對乾料還是總混合料；添加增加體積與質量，不等於污染物消失。
steps.instructionEn: Stabilization and solidification differ; record additives on a dry basis and select them through independent testing. State whether dose refers to dry feed or final mix; addition increases mass and volume but does not make contaminants disappear.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾料 m=1000 kg；假設添加比 d=0.12 kg/kg。公式 m_add=m*d，計算得 120 kg。適用邊界：紙上質量配比，不是藥劑配方；效能須另以小試和浸出試驗驗證。

steps.failure: 靠稀釋降低總濃度不等於化學固定或長期穩定。 在「乾基添加量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.title: 混合含水與成形：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Blend moisture and forming: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 混合含水與成形 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Blend moisture and forming and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 水參與反應與成形，過多水也可能增加孔隙或產生滲出，需保留水收支。 水分率的分母包含新增水，故從乾料反求加水量需除以一減水分率。
steps.instructionEn: Water supports reactions and forming, while excess may increase pores or drainage; retain the water balance. The moisture denominator includes added water, so calculating water from dry solids requires division by one minus the water fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾混料 md=100 kg；假想濕基含水分率 w=0.20。公式 mw=md*w/(1-w)，計算得 25 kg water。適用邊界：乾料起始無水、無反應耗水與蒸發；純質量換算，不是穩定化配方或現場加水建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry blend md=100 kg; hypothetical wet-basis water fraction w=0.20. Formula mw=md*w/(1-w) gives 25 kg water. Applicability: Initially dry solids with no reaction consumption or evaporation; a mass-conversion example, not a stabilization recipe or field water dose.
steps.failure: 把濕基百分比直接乘乾料重會低估水量。 在「混合含水與成形」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying a wet-basis percentage directly by dry mass understates water. Mark where this error can enter the Blend moisture and forming flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「混合含水與成形」，分開記錄原料自帶水與外加水，量混合後濕乾重量並檢查反應消耗和滲液。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Blend moisture and forming, Record inherent and added water separately, measure wet and dry blend masses and check reaction consumption and drainage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 固定介質容量概念：機制與觀察

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Immobilizing-media capacity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以抽象吸附容量模型說明有限反應能力；實際飛灰需考慮 pH 和競爭離子。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。
steps.instructionEn: Use an abstract sorption-capacity model to explain finite capacity; real ash also requires pH and competing-ion analysis. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.

steps.objective: 辨識 浸出方法與液固比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Leaching method and liquid-solid ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 方法選擇決定試驗邊界，單次萃取不能替代所有環境暴露。 浸出質量可由液體濃度和體積換算，但不能把此值當成樣品總含量。
steps.instructionEn: The test method defines its boundary; one extraction does not represent every environmental exposure. Released mass follows liquid concentration and volume, but is not the specimen total content.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：浸出液濃度 C=2 mg/L；液體體積 V=2 L；試樣乾質量 m=0.10 kg。公式 released=C*V/m，計算得 40 mg/kg dry sample。適用邊界：以單次均勻浸出作教學換算；不同方法的液固比、pH 和時間不可混用。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Leachate concentration C=2 mg/L; liquid volume V=2 L; dry specimen m=0.10 kg. Formula released=C*V/m gives 40 mg/kg dry sample. Applicability: A single homogeneous extraction for teaching conversion; do not mix liquid/solid ratios, pH or duration across methods.
steps.failure: 浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「浸出方法與液固比」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Leaching method and liquid-solid ratio flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

steps.checkEn: For Leaching method and liquid-solid ratio, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.

title: 焚化煙氣袋濾除塵
summary: 本課以「由濾餅、配流與差壓理解袋濾除塵與破袋診斷」為主軸，依序處理入口粉塵負荷、濾餅累積與阻力、出口濃度與去除率、破袋事件的時間延遲、分室診斷可信度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Understand bag filtration and failure diagnosis through cake, flow distribution and differential pressure, progressing through Inlet dust loading, Cake accumulation and resistance, Outlet concentration and removal, Timing of a bag-failure signal, Confidence in compartment diagnosis. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 入口粉塵負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inlet dust loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口粉塵負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inlet dust loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 入口濃度與實際處理氣量共同決定濾袋每天承受的粉塵，不只看濃度百分比。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet concentration and gas flow jointly determine dust presented to the bags; concentration alone is insufficient. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「入口粉塵負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Inlet dust loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「入口粉塵負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Inlet dust loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 濾布面積與過濾風速：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cloth area and filtration velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 濾布面積與過濾風速 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cloth area and filtration velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 計算在線面積時扣除停用濾室，並對照分室氣流而非假定均勻。 過濾風速由實際氣量除以可用布面積；隔離一室時其餘濾袋負荷會上升。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract isolated compartments from online area and compare compartment flows rather than assuming uniformity. Air-to-cloth velocity is actual flow divided by available area; isolating one compartment increases loading on the others.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣體流量 Q=60 m³/min；有效濾布面積 A=120 m²。公式 v=Q/A，計算得 0.5 m/min。適用邊界：平均配流近似且氣量與溫壓一致，不代表濾料容許值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas flow Q=60 m³/min; effective cloth area A=120 m². Formula v=Q/A gives 0.5 m/min. Applicability: Mean-flow approximation at consistent gas conditions, not a permitted fabric loading.
steps.failure: 把停用濾袋計入面積，會低估在線風速。 在「濾布面積與過濾風速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Counting unavailable bags understates online filtration velocity. Mark where this error can enter the Cloth area and filtration velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「濾布面積與過濾風速」，核對在線濾袋數、實際氣量與分室差壓，辨識局部超載。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Cloth area and filtration velocity, Check online bag count, actual gas flow and compartment pressure drop to identify local overloading. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 濾餅累積與阻力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cake accumulation and resistance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 濾餅累積與阻力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cake accumulation and resistance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 濾餅能捕捉細粒，也增加阻力；清灰需求需從差壓與出口一起判讀。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。
steps.instructionEn: The dust cake captures fine particles while adding resistance; interpret cleaning need using both pressure drop and outlet data. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
steps.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「濾餅累積與阻力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Cake accumulation and resistance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「濾餅累積與阻力」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Cake accumulation and resistance, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 過度清灰會耗能並擾動濾餅，不足清灰會堵塞；在模擬中比較兩種極端。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: Over-cleaning consumes energy and disrupts cake; under-cleaning causes blockage. Compare both extremes in simulation. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
steps.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「清灰週期與能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Cleaning cycles and energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「清灰週期與能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Cleaning cycles and energy, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 出口濃度與去除率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Outlet concentration and removal: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 出口濃度與去除率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Outlet concentration and removal and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 出口濃度是直接量測，去除率需配對入口；兩者不可互相取代。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet concentration is directly measured, while removal needs matched inlet data; neither replaces the other. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
steps.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「出口濃度與去除率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Outlet concentration and removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「出口濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Outlet concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 溫壓乾濕基與氧校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reference conditions and oxygen correction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溫壓乾濕基與氧校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reference conditions and oxygen correction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 保留原始報表與校正欄位，避免在溫度或含濕變化時錯判效能。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。
steps.instructionEn: Retain raw and normalized fields to avoid false performance changes when temperature or moisture changes. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
steps.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「溫壓乾濕基與氧校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.objective: 區分 監測失效與缺測 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Monitor failure and data gaps with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「監測失效與缺測」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.instructionEn: Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Monitor failure and data gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
steps.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「監測失效與缺測」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Monitor failure and data gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「監測失效與缺測」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Monitor failure and data gaps, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 監測失效與缺測
knowledge.text: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「監測失效與缺測」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
knowledge.textEn: Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Monitor failure and data gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 分室診斷可信度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Confidence in compartment diagnosis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分室診斷可信度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Confidence in compartment diagnosis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較差壓、粉塵訊號與查漏證據，明確標示哪一項尚不足以定位破袋。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure, dust signals and leak-test evidence and identify which observations cannot yet localize a failed bag. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
steps.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「分室診斷可信度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Confidence in compartment diagnosis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「分室診斷可信度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Confidence in compartment diagnosis, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

title: 煙氣脫硝系統
summary: 本課以「比較 SCR 與 SNCR 的反應、混合、逸出與監測邊界」為主軸，依序處理氮氧化物入口基準、混合與空間速度、催化床壓降與積灰、氧校正與稀釋、量測性能與校正。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Compare SCR and SNCR through reaction, mixing, reagent slip and monitoring boundaries, progressing through NOx inlet basis, Mixing and space velocity, Catalyst pressure drop and deposits, Oxygen correction and dilution, Measurement performance and calibration. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. steps.title: 混合與空間速度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mixing and space velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 混合與空間速度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mixing and space velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: SCR 催化床需均勻配流；局部高速度可能使平均空間速度掩蓋穿透。 空間速度是每小時氣量與催化劑體積之比；它與接觸尺度相關但不能單獨預測轉換率。
steps.instructionEn: An SCR catalyst bed needs uniform flow; local high velocity can cause breakthrough hidden by a mean space velocity. Gas hourly space velocity is flow divided by catalyst volume; it relates to contact scale but does not alone predict conversion.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=6000 m³/h；催化劑體積 V=3 m³。公式 GHSV=Q/V，計算得 2000 h⁻¹。適用邊界：一致溫壓基準與均勻配流；未含催化活性、溫度窗和中毒。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas flow Q=6000 m³/h; catalyst volume V=3 m³. Formula GHSV=Q/V gives 2000 h⁻¹. Applicability: Consistent gas reference and uniform distribution; catalyst activity, temperature window and poisoning are omitted.
steps.failure: 局部堵塞令可用體積下降，名目體積計算會掩蓋劣化。 在「混合與空間速度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage reduces available volume, which nominal-volume calculations can conceal. Mark where this error can enter the Mixing and space velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「混合與空間速度」，比較不同區位的流速、溫度與逸出物，檢查壓降和催化活性趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Mixing and space velocity, Compare local velocity, temperature and slip; inspect pressure-drop and activity trends. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 反應溫度與熱需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reaction temperature and heat demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 反應溫度與熱需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reaction temperature and heat demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: SCR 與 SNCR 的反應窗口不同，教學只用顯熱評估熱需求，不提供操作窗口。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。
steps.instructionEn: SCR and SNCR have different reaction windows; the lesson estimates heat demand without prescribing operating windows. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
steps.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「反應溫度與熱需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction temperature and heat demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「反應溫度與熱需求」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Reaction temperature and heat demand, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 催化床壓降與積灰：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Catalyst pressure drop and deposits: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 催化床壓降與積灰 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Catalyst pressure drop and deposits and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 催化活性下降與流道堵塞是不同失效，需將差壓與污染物轉換一起比較。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Activity loss and flow-channel blockage are different failures; compare pressure drop with conversion. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
steps.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「催化床壓降與積灰」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Catalyst pressure drop and deposits flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「催化床壓降與積灰」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Catalyst pressure drop and deposits, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 催化床壓降與積灰

steps.instruction: 提高去除率時仍須追蹤未反應藥劑，單看 NOx 下降會漏掉副作用。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。

steps.title: 分析延遲與控制判讀：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Analyzer lag and control interpretation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分析延遲與控制判讀 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Analyzer lag and control interpretation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料、藥劑和出口訊號不同步會造成假因果，先重播延遲再討論回饋。 輸送延遲會把監測訊號與製程事件錯開，分析前須對齊時間。
steps.instructionEn: Asynchronous feed, reagent and outlet signals create false causality; replay delays before interpreting feedback. Transport delay shifts monitoring signals relative to process events; align time before interpretation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：取樣管容積 V=2 L；流量 q=0.5 L/min。公式 t=V/q，計算得 4 min。適用邊界：理想置換延遲，未含混合、吸附與分析儀響應時間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Sampling-line volume V=2 L; flow q=0.5 L/min. Formula t=V/q gives 4 min. Applicability: Ideal displacement delay without mixing, adsorption or analyzer response time.
steps.failure: 管線冷凝或吸附會造成較長且不對稱的拖尾。 在「分析延遲與控制判讀」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Condensation or adsorption in tubing causes longer asymmetric tails. Mark where this error can enter the Analyzer lag and control interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「分析延遲與控制判讀」，以安全參考訊號或離線脈衝重播測全系統響應，不只使用分析儀規格。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Analyzer lag and control interpretation, Use a safe reference signal or offline pulse replay to measure whole-system response, not analyzer specifications alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 量測性能與校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Measurement performance and calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 量測性能與校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Measurement performance and calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 藥劑濃度與 NOx 儀器各有零點與跨度誤差，需用獨立標準查核。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。
steps.instructionEn: Reagent and NOx instruments have separate offset and span errors requiring independent standards. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
steps.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「量測性能與校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Measurement performance and calibration flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「量測性能與校正」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Measurement performance and calibration, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 催化劑壽命與交接：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 催化劑壽命與交接 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Catalyst life and handoff and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 交接應包含轉換、逸出、壓降和停機記錄，不能只用日曆年齡推定剩餘能力。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Handoff includes conversion, slip, pressure drop and outages; calendar age alone does not determine remaining capacity. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
steps.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「催化劑壽命與交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Catalyst life and handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「催化劑壽命與交接」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Catalyst life and handoff, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。

title: 煙氣酸性氣體洗滌
summary: 本課以「用酸性氣體質量、化學當量與液氣接觸評估洗滌流程」為主軸，依序處理酸性氣體負荷與成分、循環液與氣體接觸、循環泵與輸送能量、排污水鹽分負荷、量測校正與反應證據。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Assess acid-gas scrubbing through mass load, chemical equivalents and gas-liquid contact, progressing through Acid-gas loading and species, Recirculating-liquid contact, Recirculation-pump energy, Blowdown salt load, Calibration and reaction evidence. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.instruction: 先用已平衡的反應式建立理論當量，再將副反應與未利用藥劑列為額外證據。 化學計量給理論反應需求，實際投加還受混合、反應溫度及副反應限制。

steps.failure: 過量投加可能增加藥劑逸出或殘渣，而非繼續改善去除。 在「中和反應當量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.title: 循環液與氣體接觸：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Recirculating-liquid contact: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 循環液與氣體接觸 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recirculating-liquid contact and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 噴淋與填料潤濕決定有效接觸，總循環量正常不代表每個區域都均勻。 液氣比描述平均接觸供給，去除仍受溶解、反應與填料潤濕影響。
steps.instructionEn: Spray and packing wetting determine effective contact; normal total circulation does not guarantee uniform zones. Liquid-to-gas ratio describes mean contacting supply; removal also depends on solubility, reaction and wetting.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：循環液量 L=12 m³/h；氣量 G=6000 m³/h。公式 L_over_G=1000*L/G，計算得 2 L/m³。適用邊界：流量比教學模型，不是洗滌塔設計值；未求傳質單元數。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Recirculating liquid L=12 m³/h; gas flow G=6000 m³/h. Formula L_over_G=1000*L/G gives 2 L/m³. Applicability: A flow-ratio teaching model, not a scrubber design value; transfer units are not calculated.
steps.failure: 液體旁流造成乾區，名目液氣比正常也可能去除不良。 在「循環液與氣體接觸」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Liquid channeling creates dry zones even at a normal nominal liquid-to-gas ratio. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculating-liquid contact flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「循環液與氣體接觸」，核對液體分布、噴嘴、循環濃度與壓降，不只檢查泵流量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Recirculating-liquid contact, Check liquid distribution, nozzles, recirculating concentration and pressure drop, not pump flow alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 洗滌塔壓降與阻塞：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 洗滌塔壓降與阻塞 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 填料結垢、液泛與除霧器堵塞可能呈現不同差壓分布，需分段測量。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。

steps.title: 循環泵與輸送能量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Recirculation-pump energy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 循環泵與輸送能量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recirculation-pump energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 循環液輸送需要克服高度與管路損失，泵耗應和處理效能一起比較。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculation overcomes elevation and line losses; compare pumping demand with treatment performance. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
steps.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「循環泵與輸送能量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculation-pump energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「循環泵與輸送能量」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 排放濃度與去除率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Emission concentration and removal: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排放濃度與去除率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Emission concentration and removal and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以同一物種同一基準比較進出口，低入口負荷時不以百分比獨斷效果。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the same species and reference basis at inlet and outlet; removal percentage alone is weak evidence at low inlet load. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
steps.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「排放濃度與去除率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Emission concentration and removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「排放濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Emission concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 排放濃度與去除率
knowledge.text: 以同一物種同一基準比較進出口，低入口負荷時不以百分比獨斷效果。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the same species and reference basis at inlet and outlet; removal percentage alone is weak evidence at low inlet load. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 去除率很高就能證明出口濃度符合任何排放標準。
以同一物種同一基準比較進出口，低入口負荷時不以百分比獨斷效果。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
optionsEn: High removal efficiency proves compliance with every outlet-emission limit.
Compare the same species and reference basis at inlet and outlet; removal percentage alone is weak evidence at low inlet load.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
quiz.explanation: 以同一物種同一基準比較進出口，低入口負荷時不以百分比獨斷效果。 針對「排放濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the same species and reference basis at inlet and outlet; removal percentage alone is weak evidence at low inlet load. For Emission concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 排污水鹽分負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Blowdown salt load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排污水鹽分負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Blowdown salt load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 被捕集的酸形成液相鹽分，需追蹤排污水處理，不能把捕集等同污染消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。
steps.instructionEn: Captured acids form dissolved salts; track blowdown treatment rather than treating capture as disappearance. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
steps.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「排污水鹽分負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Blowdown salt load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「排污水鹽分負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Blowdown salt load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 水分蒸發與補水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Evaporation and makeup water: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水分蒸發與補水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Evaporation and makeup water and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 高溫煙氣與洗液交換熱與水分，補水需求需與排污和帶出分開。 相變將熱轉為水蒸氣焓；潮濕材料處理中，蒸發可能比顯熱更耗能。
steps.instructionEn: Hot gas exchanges heat and moisture with scrubbing liquid; distinguish makeup for evaporation, blowdown and carryover. Phase change transfers heat into water-vapour enthalpy; evaporation can dominate sensible heating in wet-material processing.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸發水量 m=100 kg/h；假設潛熱 hfg=2257 kJ/kg。公式 P=m*hfg/3600，計算得 62.6944 kW。適用邊界：潛熱值只代表近常壓沸點示例，不模擬其他溫壓下的完整乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Evaporated water m=100 kg/h; assumed latent heat hfg=2257 kJ/kg. Formula P=m*hfg/3600 gives 62.6944 kW. Applicability: The latent heat represents a near-atmospheric boiling example, not full drying at other conditions.
steps.failure: 把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「水分蒸發與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and makeup water flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「水分蒸發與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Evaporation and makeup water, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 量測校正與反應證據：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Calibration and reaction evidence: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 量測校正與反應證據 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Calibration and reaction evidence and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: pH、導電度和污染分析各自回應不同物理量；單一感測器正常不代表全部正常。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。
steps.instructionEn: pH, conductivity and pollutant analysis measure different quantities; one normal sensor does not validate the whole process. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
steps.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「量測校正與反應證據」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Calibration and reaction evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「量測校正與反應證據」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Calibration and reaction evidence, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.

title: 垃圾掩埋場複合襯墊
summary: 本課以「由地基、膜土接觸、焊縫與排水證據理解複合襯墊」為主軸，依序處理地形與地下水邊界、膜材缺陷與水頭效應、鋪設面積與品質覆蓋、收集槽容量與停泵、降雨與上覆水量。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Understand composite liners through foundation, membrane contact, seams and drainage evidence, progressing through Terrain and groundwater boundary, Membrane defects and head, Laying area and quality coverage, Sump capacity during pump outage, Rainfall and overlying-water balance. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 地形與地下水邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Terrain and groundwater boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地形與地下水邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Terrain and groundwater boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先將底部高程與地下水水頭分開，避免用地表坡向推定地下水流向。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。
steps.instructionEn: Separate base elevation from groundwater head; surface slope does not determine subsurface flow direction. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.

steps.title: 低滲透土層原理：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Low-permeability soil layer: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 低滲透土層原理 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Low-permeability soil layer and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 壓實土層提供水力阻抗，但其現場完整性與試體性能需各有證據。 Darcy 定律將水力梯度與材料傳導係數連結到平均滲流；薄膜缺陷流不由這條均質式代表。
steps.instructionEn: Compacted soil supplies hydraulic resistance, but field continuity and specimen performance require separate evidence. Darcy law links gradient and hydraulic conductivity to mean seepage; geomembrane defect flow is not represented by this homogeneous relation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水力傳導係數 K=1e-9 m/s；梯度 i=2；面積 A=1000 m²。公式 Q=K*i*A*86400，計算得 0.1728 m³/d。適用邊界：飽和、層流、均質材料；不含接縫孔洞、裂縫或非飽和行為。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hydraulic conductivity K=1e-9 m/s; gradient i=2; area A=1000 m². Formula Q=K*i*A*86400 gives 0.1728 m³/d. Applicability: Saturated laminar flow in homogeneous material; seams, holes, cracks and unsaturated effects are excluded.
steps.failure: 試驗室低 K 不會排除現場接縫或穿刺形成的洩漏。 在「低滲透土層原理」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Low laboratory K does not rule out leakage through field seams or punctures. Mark where this error can enter the Low-permeability soil layer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「低滲透土層原理」，核對試體飽和度、尺寸與水頭，再比較現場密實度及施工品質證據。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Low-permeability soil layer, Verify saturation, dimensions and head before comparing field density and construction quality records. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 膜材缺陷與水頭效應：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Membrane defects and head: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 膜材缺陷與水頭效應 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Membrane defects and head and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 使用理想孔口比較水頭效應，再辨認複合襯墊中膜土接觸使模型失效的地方。 自由孔口流量隨孔面積線性、隨水頭平方根變化；膜下土層接觸可顯著改變實際洩漏。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head effects with an ideal orifice, then identify where membrane-soil contact invalidates that model. Free-orifice flow scales linearly with hole area and with square-root head; contact with underlying soil can greatly alter actual leakage.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：假想自由出流孔面積 a=1e-5 m²；水頭 h=0.30 m；流量係數 Cd=0.6。公式 Q=Cd*a*sqrt(2*g*h)*86400，計算得 1.25769 m³/d。適用邊界：只示範無背壓自由孔口，不能用來預測複合襯墊實際滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hypothetical freely discharging hole a=1e-5 m²; head h=0.30 m; discharge coefficient Cd=0.6. Formula Q=Cd*a*sqrt(2*g*h)*86400 gives 1.25769 m³/d. Applicability: Only a free orifice without backpressure; not a prediction of leakage through a composite liner.
steps.failure: 忽略膜土緊密接觸或沿面流，會把簡化孔口式誤當成場址模型。 在「膜材缺陷與水頭效應」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring membrane-soil contact or interface flow turns a simplified orifice equation into a false site model. Mark where this error can enter the Membrane defects and head flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「膜材缺陷與水頭效應」，在紙上比較相同孔面積的兩種水頭，另列膜土接觸、缺陷形狀與土層 K 等缺失條件。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 焊縫試片與破壞位置：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Seam specimens and failure location: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 焊縫試片與破壞位置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Seam specimens and failure location and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同時觀察拉伸和剝離相關證據，焊縫外觀整齊不能替代機械性能。 名目拉應力由拉力除原始截面積；膜材與接縫失效還受剝離、蠕變及缺口影響。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect evidence relevant to both tensile and peel behaviour; neat seam appearance does not establish mechanical performance. Nominal tensile stress is force over original area; membrane and seam failure also depend on peel, creep and notches.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：拉力 F=500 N；試條寬 w=0.025 m；厚度 t=0.002 m。公式 stress=F/(w*t)/1e6，計算得 10 MPa。適用邊界：均勻單軸名目應力，不是材料允許應力或接縫驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Tensile force F=500 N; strip width w=0.025 m; thickness t=0.002 m. Formula stress=F/(w*t)/1e6 gives 10 MPa. Applicability: Uniform uniaxial nominal stress, not allowable stress or a seam acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 只報最大拉力而不報尺寸，無法公平比較不同試片。 在「焊縫試片與破壞位置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Maximum force without specimen dimensions cannot compare samples fairly. Mark where this error can enter the Seam specimens and failure location flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「焊縫試片與破壞位置」，記錄試片尺寸、載入速率與破壞位置，區分母材、焊縫和夾具滑移。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Seam specimens and failure location, Record specimen size, loading rate and failure location, distinguishing parent sheet, weld and grip slip. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Laying area and quality coverage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把板片、接縫和穿越處編號，採樣圖需指出未檢區與特殊細部。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Identify panels, seams and penetrations; the inspection map must show untested regions and details. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「鋪設面積與品質覆蓋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Laying area and quality coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「鋪設面積與品質覆蓋」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Laying area and quality coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 排水坡向與局部窪地：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Drainage grade and depressions: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排水坡向與局部窪地 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Drainage grade and depressions and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 襯墊上積水增加水頭；設計坡向需在鋪設後以實測高程核對。 坡度影響重力排水方向；沉陷可改變原有坡向並產生積水。
steps.instructionEn: Ponding above the liner increases head; verify installed grades by survey. Slope controls gravity-drainage direction; settlement can reverse grades and create ponding.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：落差 Δz=1.5 m；水平長度 L=50 m。公式 slope=dz/L*100，計算得 3 %。適用邊界：幾何坡度計算，不推定滑動穩定或排水容量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Elevation drop Δz=1.5 m; horizontal run L=50 m. Formula slope=dz/L*100 gives 3 %. Applicability: Geometric slope only; slope stability and drainage capacity are not determined.
steps.failure: 端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「排水坡向與局部窪地」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Drainage grade and depressions flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「排水坡向與局部窪地」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Drainage grade and depressions, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 辨識 收集槽容量與停泵 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sump capacity during pump outage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重播假想停泵並追蹤水位，將暫存容量和膜上水頭連結。 儲量變化等於流入減流出的時間積分；尖峰可能超過平均設計流量。
steps.instructionEn: Replay a hypothetical pump outage and relate storage to head above the membrane. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow; peaks can exceed average design flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流入 Qin=30 m³/h；排出 Qout=20 m³/h；持續 t=4 h。公式 dV=(Qin-Qout)*t，計算得 40 m³。適用邊界：固定流量時段與已知初始儲量，不含蒸發或滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inflow Qin=30 m³/h; outflow Qout=20 m³/h; duration t=4 h. Formula dV=(Qin-Qout)*t gives 40 m³. Applicability: Constant flows over the interval and known initial storage; evaporation and leaks are omitted.

steps.check: 針對「收集槽容量與停泵」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Sump capacity during pump outage, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 集排水泵送需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Collection-pump duty: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集排水泵送需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Collection-pump duty and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排水需求與處理場接收能力連結，泵送功率不能代替防滲性能證明。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。

steps.title: 降雨與上覆水量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rainfall and overlying-water balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 降雨與上覆水量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rainfall and overlying-water balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分開未覆蓋施工期與運轉期降雨情境，避免同一逕流假設套用全部階段。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。
steps.instructionEn: Separate construction and operational rainfall scenarios rather than applying one runoff assumption throughout. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
steps.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨與上覆水量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall and overlying-water balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「降雨與上覆水量」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Rainfall and overlying-water balance, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
