steps.instruction: 將材料批號、焊縫試驗、修補位置與滲流監測串成可追溯紀錄。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.

title: 掩埋場滲出水收集
summary: 本課以「以水量、排水路徑和污染負荷設計滲出水收集的教學模型」為主軸，依序處理滲出水產生與水量邊界、穿孔管有效通流、泵送揚程與輸送、有機與鹽分輸出負荷、液位與流量感測校正。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Model leachate collection through water balance, drainage paths and pollutant loading, progressing through Leachate generation and water boundary, Perforated-pipe conveyance, Pumping head and transfer, Organic and salt export load, Level and flow calibration. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 滲出水產生與水量邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Leachate generation and water boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 滲出水產生與水量邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Leachate generation and water boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 雨水、廢棄物初始含水與生物產水來源不同，先定義計算期間再估入流。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。
steps.instructionEn: Rain, initial waste moisture and biological water differ; define the accounting period before estimating inflow. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
steps.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「滲出水產生與水量邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Leachate generation and water boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「滲出水產生與水量邊界」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Leachate generation and water boundary, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 集排水層坡向：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Collection-layer grades: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集排水層坡向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Collection-layer grades and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排水層需導向集水點，局部反坡會增加水頭與積存。 坡度影響重力排水方向；沉陷可改變原有坡向並產生積水。
steps.instructionEn: The drainage layer must lead to sumps; reverse grades increase head and hold-up. Slope controls gravity-drainage direction; settlement can reverse grades and create ponding.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：落差 Δz=1.5 m；水平長度 L=50 m。公式 slope=dz/L*100，計算得 3 %。適用邊界：幾何坡度計算，不推定滑動穩定或排水容量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Elevation drop Δz=1.5 m; horizontal run L=50 m. Formula slope=dz/L*100 gives 3 %. Applicability: Geometric slope only; slope stability and drainage capacity are not determined.
steps.failure: 端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「集排水層坡向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Collection-layer grades flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「集排水層坡向」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Collection-layer grades, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 穿孔管有效通流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Perforated-pipe conveyance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 穿孔管有效通流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Perforated-pipe conveyance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 管壁開孔收集與管內輸送是不同環節，平均管速不能證明所有開孔通暢。 滿管平均速度由流量除截面積；結垢縮小內徑可同時增加速度和阻力。
steps.instructionEn: Collection through openings differs from internal conveyance; mean pipe velocity does not prove clear perforations. Full-pipe mean velocity is flow divided by area; scale reduces diameter and can increase both velocity and resistance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：圓管內徑 D=0.10 m；流量 Q=0.005 m³/s。公式 v=4*Q/(pi*D²)，計算得 0.63662 m/s。適用邊界：圓形滿管、無滑移平均值；未計部分充滿、泥砂和非牛頓特性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Circular pipe internal diameter D=0.10 m; flow Q=0.005 m³/s. Formula v=4*Q/(pi*D²) gives 0.63662 m/s. Applicability: Circular full pipe and mean velocity; partly full flow, sediment and non-Newtonian behaviour are excluded.
steps.failure: 使用外徑或名目尺寸代替有效內徑會低估速度。 在「穿孔管有效通流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using outer or nominal diameter instead of effective inner diameter understates velocity. Mark where this error can enter the Perforated-pipe conveyance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「穿孔管有效通流」，核對真實內徑與流量，再觀察沖洗前後壓力、固體沉積和流量恢復。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Perforated-pipe conveyance, Verify actual internal diameter and flow, then compare pressure, deposits and flow recovery before and after cleaning. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 集水槽尖峰暫存：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Peak sump storage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集水槽尖峰暫存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Peak sump storage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將暴雨短時入流與泵送能力重播，找出最高液位而不只看日平均。 儲量變化等於流入減流出的時間積分；尖峰可能超過平均設計流量。
steps.instructionEn: Replay storm-peak inflow against pumping capacity to identify maximum level rather than daily means. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow; peaks can exceed average design flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流入 Qin=30 m³/h；排出 Qout=20 m³/h；持續 t=4 h。公式 dV=(Qin-Qout)*t，計算得 40 m³。適用邊界：固定流量時段與已知初始儲量，不含蒸發或滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inflow Qin=30 m³/h; outflow Qout=20 m³/h; duration t=4 h. Formula dV=(Qin-Qout)*t gives 40 m³. Applicability: Constant flows over the interval and known initial storage; evaporation and leaks are omitted.
steps.failure: 只用日平均流量會忽略短時暴雨造成的積存。 在「集水槽尖峰暫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Daily mean flow misses storage needed during short storm peaks. Mark where this error can enter the Peak sump storage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「集水槽尖峰暫存」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Peak sump storage, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 泵送揚程與輸送：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pumping head and transfer: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 泵送揚程與輸送 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pumping head and transfer and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把集水深度、管損與末端高程列入總揚程，再核對實際泵點。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。
steps.instructionEn: Include sump depth, line losses and discharge elevation in total head, then verify the pump operating point. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
steps.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「泵送揚程與輸送」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Pumping head and transfer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「泵送揚程與輸送」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Pumping head and transfer, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 堵塞與差壓診斷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Clogging and pressure diagnosis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 堵塞與差壓診斷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Clogging and pressure diagnosis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沉積、生物膜與結垢可能共同堵塞，壓差變化須連同流量判讀。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment, biofilm and scaling can combine to block drainage; interpret pressure changes with flow. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
steps.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「堵塞與差壓診斷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Clogging and pressure diagnosis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「堵塞與差壓診斷」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Clogging and pressure diagnosis, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 有機與鹽分輸出負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic and salt export load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有機與鹽分輸出負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic and salt export load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 高濃度小水量與低濃度大水量可能有相同負荷，後段處理需知道兩者。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。
steps.instructionEn: A small concentrated flow and a large dilute flow can carry equal load; downstream treatment needs both quantities. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
steps.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「有機與鹽分輸出負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Organic and salt export load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「有機與鹽分輸出負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Organic and salt export load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.textEn: A small concentrated flow and a large dilute flow can carry equal load; downstream treatment needs both quantities. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.

knowledge.text: 只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 調勻池停留與混合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Equalization residence and mixing: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 調勻池停留與混合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Equalization residence and mixing and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 調勻可降低波動但不自動去除污染，沉積和死區需有額外觀察。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。
steps.instructionEn: Equalization reduces variability but does not automatically remove pollutants; sediment and dead zones need separate observation. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
steps.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「調勻池停留與混合」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Equalization residence and mixing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「調勻池停留與混合」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Equalization residence and mixing, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

steps.title: 液位與流量感測校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Level and flow calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 液位與流量感測校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Level and flow calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 液位漂移可能掩蓋泵故障，需用獨立量測確認儀表零點與量程。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。
steps.instructionEn: Level drift can conceal pump faults; independent measurement checks offset and range. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
steps.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「液位與流量感測校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Level and flow calibration flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「液位與流量感測校正」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Level and flow calibration, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

summary: 本課以「建立掩埋甲烷生成、收集、氧化與利用的分流收支」為主軸，依序處理有機物庫存與可分解部分、收集與表面逸散、集氣風機能量、甲烷能量利用、井網監測與資料缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Balance generated landfill methane among collection, oxidation and utilization, progressing through Organic inventory and degradable fraction, Collection and surface escape, Gas-collection blower energy, Methane energy utilization, Well-network monitoring gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. steps.instruction: 以一階模型比較反應速度假設，明確保留多批次投入與含水差異未被解析。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。

steps.title: 收集與表面逸散：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Collection and surface escape: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 收集與表面逸散 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Collection and surface escape and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 抽氣井回收的量只是生成量的一部分，覆土氧化與未收集逸散需分帳。 收集、覆土氧化與逸散分屬不同通量；氧化率應作用於剩餘通量而非總量重複扣除。
steps.instructionEn: Well collection is only part of generation; account separately for cover oxidation and uncollected escape. Collection, cover oxidation and escape are separate fluxes; oxidation acts on the remaining flux rather than being subtracted twice.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：生成甲烷 G=100 m³/h；假設收集率 c=0.70；氧化率 o=0.10（僅作用於未收集部分）。公式 escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o)，計算得 27 m³ CH₄/h。適用邊界：假想均勻平均率，不代表掩埋場實測或法定排放係數。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Generated methane G=100 m³/h; assumed collection c=0.70; oxidation o=0.10 applied only to uncollected gas. Formula escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o) gives 27 m³ CH₄/h. Applicability: Hypothetical uniform mean rates, not field observations or regulatory emission factors.

steps.instruction: 過度負壓可能吸入空氣並改變氣質；讀值需和氧及甲烷組成一起看。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。

steps.title: 集氣風機能量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gas-collection blower energy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集氣風機能量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gas-collection blower energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 管網阻力、冷凝液與井數影響風機需求，增加功率不保證增加有效甲烷回收。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: Network resistance, condensate and well count affect blower duty; more power does not guarantee more effective methane recovery. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
steps.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「集氣風機能量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Gas-collection blower energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「集氣風機能量」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Gas-collection blower energy, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 氣體污染物負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gas-contaminant loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氣體污染物負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 氣體中的硫化物或其他雜質需按氣量和濃度估負荷，才能比較淨化需求。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate impurity loading from gas volume and concentration before comparing conditioning requirements. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「氣體污染物負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Gas-contaminant loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

steps.checkEn: For Gas-contaminant loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 淨能量與自用電：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Net energy and internal electricity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 淨能量與自用電 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Net energy and internal electricity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 收集、淨化與發電輔機都應進入能量帳，避免只展示發電機毛輸出。 淨輸出必須扣除系統內輔機；邊界決定哪些用電應納入。
steps.instructionEn: Include collection, conditioning and generator auxiliaries rather than showing gross generator output alone. Net output subtracts internal auxiliaries; the chosen system boundary determines which loads belong in the account.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：毛發電 Eg=1200 kWh/d；風機 Ef=160 kWh/d；泵 Ep=90 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep，計算得 950 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一日與同一電表邊界，未計外購熱和建造能耗。

steps.title: 停機情境與氣體去向：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Outages and gas disposition: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 停機情境與氣體去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Outages and gas disposition and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在數位流程中比較利用設備停機時的替代處理邊界，記錄各通量而非假設氣體停止生成。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Compare alternative handling boundaries when utilization equipment is offline; log fluxes rather than assuming generation stops. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
steps.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「停機情境與氣體去向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Outages and gas disposition flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「停機情境與氣體去向」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Outages and gas disposition, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

title: 掩埋場最終覆蓋
summary: 本課以「將防滲、排水、沉陷與植生整合為掩埋場最終覆蓋證據」為主軸，依序處理覆蓋層功能分工、低滲透層完整性、差異沉陷與裂縫、植生含水與季節、巡查空間覆蓋。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Integrate infiltration control, drainage, settlement and vegetation into landfill-cover evidence, progressing through Roles of cover layers, Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Differential settlement and cracking, Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Inspection spatial coverage. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 覆蓋層功能分工：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Roles of cover layers: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 覆蓋層功能分工 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Roles of cover layers and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將植生層、排水層與低滲透層分開，材料體積與壓實狀態要依各層記帳。 材料體積依堆積密度而變；粒子密度不可直接代替含孔隙的堆積密度。
steps.instructionEn: Separate vegetation, drainage and low-permeability layers, accounting for volume and compaction by layer. Material volume depends on bulk density; particle density cannot replace density including pores.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：固體質量 m=6000 kg；假設堆積密度 rho=1500 kg/m³。公式 V=m/rho，計算得 4 m³。適用邊界：已知乾濕基與均勻堆積，未包含後續壓密與膨脹。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Solid mass m=6000 kg; assumed bulk density rho=1500 kg/m³. Formula V=m/rho gives 4 m³. Applicability: Known moisture basis and uniform packing; later consolidation and swelling are omitted.
steps.failure: 把粒子密度當堆積密度會低估運輸或覆層需要體積。 在「覆蓋層功能分工」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using particle density as bulk density underestimates hauling or cover volume. Mark where this error can enter the Roles of cover layers flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「覆蓋層功能分工」，用已知容積箱和秤重核對密度，將鬆填、壓實與乾濕狀態分欄。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Roles of cover layers, Check density using a known-volume container and scale, separating loose, compacted, wet and dry conditions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 降雨、蒸散與滲漏：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 降雨、蒸散與滲漏 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 蒸散型與低滲透型覆蓋的主導機制不同，水量比較需保留儲水項。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。
steps.instructionEn: Evapotranspirative and low-permeability covers rely on different mechanisms; retain storage in water comparisons. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
steps.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.title: 低滲透層完整性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Integrity of the low-permeability layer: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 低滲透層完整性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Integrity of the low-permeability layer and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 干濕循環和裂縫可能破壞連續性，試體低滲透性不能代替覆蓋後的監測。 Darcy 定律將水力梯度與材料傳導係數連結到平均滲流；薄膜缺陷流不由這條均質式代表。
steps.instructionEn: Wetting-drying cycles and cracks can disrupt continuity; low specimen permeability does not replace post-installation monitoring. Darcy law links gradient and hydraulic conductivity to mean seepage; geomembrane defect flow is not represented by this homogeneous relation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水力傳導係數 K=1e-9 m/s；梯度 i=2；面積 A=1000 m²。公式 Q=K*i*A*86400，計算得 0.1728 m³/d。適用邊界：飽和、層流、均質材料；不含接縫孔洞、裂縫或非飽和行為。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hydraulic conductivity K=1e-9 m/s; gradient i=2; area A=1000 m². Formula Q=K*i*A*86400 gives 0.1728 m³/d. Applicability: Saturated laminar flow in homogeneous material; seams, holes, cracks and unsaturated effects are excluded.
steps.failure: 試驗室低 K 不會排除現場接縫或穿刺形成的洩漏。 在「低滲透層完整性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Low laboratory K does not rule out leakage through field seams or punctures. Mark where this error can enter the Integrity of the low-permeability layer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「低滲透層完整性」，核對試體飽和度、尺寸與水頭，再比較現場密實度及施工品質證據。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Verify saturation, dimensions and head before comparing field density and construction quality records. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 低滲透層完整性

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 K 改成 2e-9 m/s，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.1728 變成 0.3456 m³/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Differential settlement and cracking and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 廢棄物壓縮與分解造成不均沉陷，覆蓋系統應以時間序列檢查局部梯度。 差異沉陷相對距離給角變形尺度；平均沉陷不能描述接縫及排水層局部拉伸。
steps.instructionEn: Waste compression and decomposition cause uneven settlement; inspect local gradients over time. Differential settlement over spacing gives an angular-distortion scale; mean settlement misses local stretching of seams and drainage layers.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原覆層厚度 H=1.2 m；假想差異沉陷 Δs=0.08 m；水平距離 L=8 m。公式 distortion=ds/L，計算得 0.01 m/m。適用邊界：小變形幾何指標，H 只作剖面背景；不代替膜材應變分析。

steps.instruction: 沉陷和溫度作用會拉扯膜與接縫，試驗需辨識破壞位置而不只報最大力。 名目拉應力由拉力除原始截面積；膜材與接縫失效還受剝離、蠕變及缺口影響。

steps.title: 植生含水與季節：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Vegetation moisture and seasonality: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 植生含水與季節 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Vegetation moisture and seasonality and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 表土太乾影響植生，過濕影響根系通氣；季節監測需記錄層位與含水基準。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。
steps.instructionEn: Dry cover soil stresses plants while saturation restricts root aeration; retain layer and moisture basis in seasonal monitoring. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
steps.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「植生含水與季節」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Vegetation moisture and seasonality flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「植生含水與季節」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

steps.title: 覆土甲烷氧化邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cover methane-oxidation boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 覆土甲烷氧化邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cover methane-oxidation boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧化只能作用於到達含氧反應區的甲烷，不能用單一假定率抹去所有排放。 收集、覆土氧化與逸散分屬不同通量；氧化率應作用於剩餘通量而非總量重複扣除。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidation acts only on methane reaching an oxygenated zone; one assumed rate cannot erase all emissions. Collection, cover oxidation and escape are separate fluxes; oxidation acts on the remaining flux rather than being subtracted twice.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：生成甲烷 G=100 m³/h；假設收集率 c=0.70；氧化率 o=0.10（僅作用於未收集部分）。公式 escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o)，計算得 27 m³ CH₄/h。適用邊界：假想均勻平均率，不代表掩埋場實測或法定排放係數。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Generated methane G=100 m³/h; assumed collection c=0.70; oxidation o=0.10 applied only to uncollected gas. Formula escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o) gives 27 m³ CH₄/h. Applicability: Hypothetical uniform mean rates, not field observations or regulatory emission factors.
steps.failure: 只從抽氣量反推生成量會把假定收集效率當成觀測。 在「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Inferring generation from collected gas alone turns an assumed efficiency into an apparent observation. Mark where this error can enter the Cover methane-oxidation boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」，把收集流量、表面通量與氣體組成併看，保留不可量測項的不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Cover methane-oxidation boundary, Combine collected flow, surface flux and gas composition while retaining uncertainty in unmeasured terms. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 巡查空間覆蓋：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inspection spatial coverage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 巡查空間覆蓋 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inspection spatial coverage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將裂縫、侵蝕、植生缺口和積水圖層疊合，規則網格之外仍需追蹤異常。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay cracks, erosion, vegetation gaps and ponding, following anomalies beyond the regular inspection grid. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「巡查空間覆蓋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Inspection spatial coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「巡查空間覆蓋」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Inspection spatial coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

title: 污染土壤洗滌
summary: 本課以「追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌」為主軸，依序處理場址分區與代表樣本、乾基污染庫存、洗液負荷與水循環、含水與產品重量、泵送與洗滌能耗。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water, progressing through Site zones and representative samples, Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Wash-water load and recycle, Moisture and product mass, Pumping and washing energy. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. steps.objective: 辨識 污染細粒與粒徑分級 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contaminated fines and size classification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 細粒高比表面常富集吸附污染物，洗滌可將它們集中而非化學消滅。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。
steps.instructionEn: High-surface-area fines often concentrate sorbed contaminants; washing can concentrate rather than destroy them. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.

steps.title: 乾基污染庫存：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dry-basis contaminant inventory: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 乾基污染庫存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dry-basis contaminant inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料污染總量需結合乾重和分析濃度，含水變化不能冒充去污。 先把濕土換成乾重，再乘相同乾基分析濃度；mg 污染物最後換算成 kg，避免含水率假造移除量。
steps.instructionEn: Initial contaminant inventory requires dry mass and concentration; moisture changes cannot stand in for cleanup. Convert wet soil to dry mass before multiplying by matching dry-basis concentration, then convert pollutant mg to kg to avoid moisture-driven apparent removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤濕重 mw=1000 kg；濕基水分 w=0.30；乾基濃度 Cd=200 mg/kg dry。公式 mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6，計算得 0.14 kg contaminant。適用邊界：含水率和濃度代表同批土壤，未含洗液或其他出口，分析濃度不是總土壤成分百分比。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet soil mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30; dry-basis concentration Cd=200 mg/kg dry. Formula mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6 gives 0.14 kg contaminant. Applicability: Moisture and concentration represent the same soil batch; wash water and other outlets are excluded, and analytical concentration is not bulk component percentage.
steps.failure: 將乾基濃度乘濕重會高估污染庫存，且使不同含水批次不可比。 在「乾基污染庫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying dry-basis concentration by wet mass overstates inventory and prevents fair comparison across moisture states. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis contaminant inventory flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「乾基污染庫存」，同步取含水與化學分析樣，核對乾基標記及 mg/kg 單位，再與全部固液出口比對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Collect moisture and chemical samples together, verify dry-basis labels and mg/kg units and reconcile all solid and liquid outlets. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Recalculate the teaching example for Dry-basis contaminant inventory and verify units and assumptions.
steps.instruction: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤濕重 mw=1000 kg；濕基水分 w=0.30；乾基濃度 Cd=200 mg/kg dry。公式 mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6，計算得 0.14 kg contaminant。適用邊界：含水率和濃度代表同批土壤，未含洗液或其他出口，分析濃度不是總土壤成分百分比。
steps.instructionEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet soil mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30; dry-basis concentration Cd=200 mg/kg dry. Formula mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6 gives 0.14 kg contaminant. Applicability: Moisture and concentration represent the same soil batch; wash water and other outlets are excluded, and analytical concentration is not bulk component percentage.

Formula mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6 gives 0.14 kg contaminant. Applicability: Moisture and concentration represent the same soil batch; wash water and other outlets are excluded, and analytical concentration is not bulk component percentage.
steps.failure: 將乾基濃度乘濕重會高估污染庫存，且使不同含水批次不可比。 在「乾基污染庫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying dry-basis concentration by wet mass overstates inventory and prevents fair comparison across moisture states. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis contaminant inventory flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「乾基污染庫存」，同步取含水與化學分析樣，核對乾基標記及 mg/kg 單位，再與全部固液出口比對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 粗細料污染收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Coarse-fine contaminant balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 粗細料污染收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Coarse-fine contaminant balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將洗後粗料與細泥同時化驗，檢查污染物是否被集中到需要後續處理的物流。 洗滌把污染物集中到細粒或水相，清潔粗料改善須以所有出口的質量收支支持。
steps.instructionEn: Assay washed coarse soil and fines together to confirm transfer into a stream needing further treatment. Washing transfers contaminants into fines or water; improved coarse material must be supported by a balance across all outlets.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤 m=1000 kg；原濃度 C0=200 mg/kg；細粒產物 mf=200 kg、Cf=800 mg/kg。公式 remaining=(m*C0-mf*Cf)/(m-mf)，計算得 50 mg/kg。適用邊界：雙固體出口、無水相流失的簡化；真實洗滌需另量洗液和污泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil m=1000 kg; initial C0=200 mg/kg; fine product mf=200 kg with Cf=800 mg/kg. Formula remaining=(m*C0-mf*Cf)/(m-mf) gives 50 mg/kg. Applicability: A two-solid-output example with no aqueous loss; real washing must also quantify wash water and sludge.
steps.failure: 只檢驗粗料而忽略細泥，會遺失污染轉移的去向。 在「粗細料污染收支」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Testing only coarse solids loses the contaminant transferred to fines. Mark where this error can enter the Coarse-fine contaminant balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「粗細料污染收支」，同步量粗細料乾重和濃度，加入洗液負荷後檢查閉合率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Coarse-fine contaminant balance, Measure dry masses and concentrations of both solids and include wash-water load in closure checks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Assay washed coarse soil and fines together to confirm transfer into a stream needing further treatment. Washing transfers contaminants into fines or water; improved coarse material must be supported by a balance across all outlets.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 Cf 改成 700 mg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50 變成 75 mg/kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only fine-product Cf to 700 mg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 50 to 75 mg/kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 洗液負荷與水循環：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wash-water load and recycle: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 洗液負荷與水循環 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wash-water load and recycle and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 循環水可累積溶解污染物，回用不代表污染負荷從系統消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。
steps.instructionEn: Recycled water can accumulate dissolved contaminants; reuse does not remove their load from the system. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
steps.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「洗液負荷與水循環」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Wash-water load and recycle flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「洗液負荷與水循環」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Wash-water load and recycle, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 固液停留與分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Solids-liquid residence and separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 固液停留與分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Solids-liquid residence and separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 攪拌和分離的停留時間不同，需防止細泥隨粗料帶出。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing and separation have different residence needs; prevent fines from leaving with coarse product. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
steps.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「固液停留與分離」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Solids-liquid residence and separation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「固液停留與分離」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Solids-liquid residence and separation, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 有相同平均停留時間的設備，其所有粒子停留時間都相同。
攪拌和分離的停留時間不同，需防止細泥隨粗料帶出。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
optionsEn: Equal mean residence times imply identical residence times for every particle.
Mixing and separation have different residence needs; prevent fines from leaving with coarse product.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

quiz.explanationEn: Mixing and separation have different residence needs; prevent fines from leaving with coarse product. For Solids-liquid residence and separation, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 含水與產品重量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture and product mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 含水與產品重量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture and product mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 洗後土壤很濕，評估減量或回收時必須回到一致乾基。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。
steps.instructionEn: Washed soil is wet; compare reduction or recovery on a common dry basis. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
steps.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「含水與產品重量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and product mass flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「含水與產品重量」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture and product mass, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.titleEn: Mass closure and unresolved pathways: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 質量閉合與未知去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mass closure and unresolved pathways and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 如果各出口污染總量無法閉合，先檢查含水、取樣與洗液，再討論反應。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: If outlet inventories do not close, check moisture, sampling and wash water before claiming reaction. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
steps.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「質量閉合與未知去向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Mass closure and unresolved pathways flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

workedExample.title: 教學算例

workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.

title: 污水泵站堵塞預防
titleEn: Clogging prevention in sewage pump stations
summary: 本課以濕井、格柵、泵曲線與堵塞預兆為主線，從來水與纖維物辨識、格柵有效通水面積、壓力管流速情境、濕井庫存與停留進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops wet wells, screens, pump curves and clogging precursors through ten connected units, beginning with influent and fibrous-material mapping, effective screen flow area, force-main velocity scenarios, wet-well inventory and residence. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.instruction: 把濕紙巾、纖維、砂與油脂分開標記；不同堵塞物需要不同前端攔截與維護證據。

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Original passage area=0.10 m²; blocked area=0.03 m². Model Af=At-Ab gives 0.07 m². Applicability: Geometric open area is not remaining pump performance; compare the pump curve.

steps.instruction: 原創教學假設：原通流面積=0.10 m²；堵塞面積=0.03 m²。模型 Af=At-Ab，代入得到 0.07 m²。適用邊界：幾何通流面積不等於泵的剩餘性能，必須對照泵曲線。

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effective screen flow area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 攔污減少自由面積，可能提高局部速度與水頭損失；應看前後水位差而非只看表面乾淨。
steps.instructionEn: Retained material reduces open area and can increase local velocity/head loss; inspect level difference, not appearance alone.

steps.title: 壓力管流速情境：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Force-main velocity scenarios: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 壓力管流速情境 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Force-main velocity scenarios and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 流量與管徑決定平均速度，低流速沉積與高流速損失需分開評估；速度不是纖維通過保證。
steps.instructionEn: Flow and diameter set mean velocity; deposition and high-velocity losses require separate assessment, and velocity does not guarantee fiber passage.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=0.05 m³/s；管內徑 D=0.25 m。模型 v=4Q/(πD²)，代入得到 1.0185916 m/s。適用邊界：滿管平均流速；不等於局部剪應力或保證不堵塞。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.05 m³/s; pipe inner diameter D=0.25 m. Model v=4Q/(πD²) gives 1.0185916 m/s. Applicability: Full-pipe mean velocity, not local shear or a guarantee against clogging.
steps.failure: 平均速度足夠卻忽略彎頭局部掛料。診斷與介入：核對實際管徑及流量，查彎頭、纖維與沉積證據。
steps.failureEn: Adequate mean velocity hides snagging at fittings. Diagnostic response: Check actual diameter/flow and inspect fittings, fibers and deposits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「壓力管流速情境」的觀測點。由流量與實際內徑計算，配合沉積與纖維觀察。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for force-main velocity scenarios. Calculate from flow and actual diameter and compare with deposits/fibers. steps.instruction: 液位變化反映進出流量差；過長停留可能影響沉積與水質，計算只作離線情境。

steps.instruction: 水力功率由流量、揚程與效率決定，關閉閥或堵塞改變工作點，不能只比較電流。
steps.instructionEn: Flow, head and efficiency determine pumping power; throttling or clogging moves the duty point, so current alone is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=0.05 m³/s；H=12 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；η=0.70。模型 P=ρgQH/(1000η)，代入得到 8.4085714 kW。適用邊界：定常不可壓縮泵功率，不含變頻與馬達以外的附屬負載。

steps.failureEn: Lower current is misread as successful energy savings. Diagnostic response: Match flow, head, speed and electricity before comparing duty points.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「揚程與輸送功率」的觀測點。同步量流量、壓差、功率，避免用銘牌功率代替實測。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.title: 雨峰與故障重播：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Storm-peak and failure replay: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨峰與故障重播 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Storm-peak and failure replay and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把峰流、單機停用與液位感測失準分開注入數位情境，檢查溢流與備援限制。
steps.instructionEn: Inject peak inflow, unit outage and level-sensor bias separately in the digital scenario to test overflow and redundancy constraints.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
steps.failure: 同時更動所有輸入而無法辨識失效原因。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。
steps.failureEn: Changing all inputs together prevents fault attribution. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「雨峰與故障重播」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for storm-peak and failure replay. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：原通流面積=0.10 m²；堵塞面積=0.03 m²。模型 Af=At-Ab，代入得到 0.07 m²。適用邊界：幾何通流面積不等於泵的剩餘性能，必須對照泵曲線。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Original passage area=0.10 m²; blocked area=0.03 m². Model Af=At-Ab gives 0.07 m². Applicability: Geometric open area is not remaining pump performance; compare the pump curve.

title: 污水管渠硫化氫腐蝕控制
summary: 本課以硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界為主線，從厭氧停留與來源、總硫化物水相負荷、pH 與水相分配、跌水逸散與氣相量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with anaerobic retention and sources, total aqueous sulfide load, ph and aqueous speciation, release at drops and gas monitoring. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 厭氧停留與來源：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 厭氧停留與來源 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Anaerobic retention and sources and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 有機物與硫酸鹽在缺氧管段可形成硫化物；先畫長停留區、壓力管及跌水點，再談控制。
steps.instructionEn: Organic matter and sulfate can support sulfide formation in anaerobic reaches; map retention zones, force mains and drops before selecting control.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
steps.failure: 只檢查臭味出口而未追溯上游生成區。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。
steps.failureEn: Only the odor outlet is checked, leaving upstream generation unmapped. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.

steps.title: 總硫化物水相負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Total aqueous sulfide load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總硫化物水相負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Total aqueous sulfide load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先統一硫質量基準，採樣保存不當會讓氧化或揮發被誤認為真去除。
steps.instructionEn: Use a common sulfur-mass basis; poor sample preservation can make oxidation or volatilization appear to be treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=800 m³/d；總溶解硫化物=4 mg S/L。模型 LS=QC/1000，代入得到 3.2 kg S/d。適用邊界：硫基準水相負荷，不是空氣中 H2S 濃度；採樣須避免氧化與揮發損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=800 m³/d; total dissolved sulfide=4 mg S/L. Model LS=QC/1000 gives 3.2 kg S/d. Applicability: Aqueous sulfur-basis load, not airborne H2S concentration; sampling must prevent oxidation and volatilization loss.
steps.failure: 硫與 H2S 分子質量混用。診斷與介入：核對保存、氧化及揮發損失，重新建立硫質量基準。
steps.failureEn: Sulfur mass and H2S molecular mass are mixed. Diagnostic response: Check preservation, oxidation and volatilization losses and rebuild the sulfur basis.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「總硫化物水相負荷」的觀測點。採樣保存與分析方法成對記錄，對比流量加權樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total aqueous sulfide load. Record preservation and analytical methods together and compare flow-weighted samples. steps.title: pH 與水相分配：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 pH 與水相分配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 未解離 H2S 比例受 pH 與溫度影響；此平衡不會直接給出呼吸高度的氣體濃度。
steps.instructionEn: The undissociated H2S fraction depends on pH and temperature; aqueous equilibrium does not directly give breathing-zone concentration.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：總溶解硫化物=5 mg S/L；pH=7；假設 pKa1=7。模型 H2S-S=ST/(1+10^(pH-pKa))，代入得到 2.5 mg S/L。適用邊界：忽略第二解離及非理想活度；不是空氣 H2S 濃度或安全判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Total dissolved sulfide=5 mg S/L; pH=7; assumed pKa1=7. Model H2S-S=ST/(1+10^(pH-pKa)) gives 2.5 mg S/L. Applicability: Neglects second dissociation/nonideal activity; it is neither airborne H2S nor a safety determination.
steps.failure: 把水相 H2S 算式當作空氣安全證明。診斷與介入：校正水相 pH、溫度及保存方法，另用氣相量測判讀逸散。
steps.failureEn: An aqueous-H2S calculation is used as proof of air safety. Diagnostic response: Correct aqueous pH, temperature and preservation, using separate gas measurements for release.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「pH 與水相分配」的觀測點。以封閉自動取樣資料比較 pH、硫化物與氣相讀值；不進入管渠。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ph and aqueous speciation. Compare closed automated samples for pH/sulfide with gas readings; do not enter sewers. steps.objective: 辨識 冠部酸蝕與材料損失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Crown acid attack and material loss and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 潮濕管冠的生物氧化可能造成酸蝕；用連續厚度與表面紀錄辨識進展，而非單張照片。
steps.instructionEn: Biological oxidation on a damp crown can cause acid attack; track thickness and surface condition over time, not a single image.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假想試片厚度減少=0.6 mm；觀察=2 yr。模型 r=Δh/t，代入得到 0.3 mm/yr。適用邊界：線性平均不保證未來速率；局部腐蝕與結構強度須另評估。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical coupon thickness loss=0.6 mm; observation=2 yr. Model r=Δh/t gives 0.3 mm/yr. Applicability: Linear average does not predict future rate; local attack and structural strength need separate assessment.
steps.failure: 沉積層厚度被當作完整結構厚度。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。
steps.failureEn: Deposit thickness is confused with sound structural thickness. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「冠部酸蝕與材料損失」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for crown acid attack and material loss. Compare multiple thickness points, material, moisture and acidic-surface records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Δh:0.6→0.8 mm，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.3 變為 0.4 mm/yr。用「冠部酸蝕與材料損失」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Δh:0.6→0.8 mm, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.3 to 0.4 mm/yr. Explain the direction using crown acid attack and material loss, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 通風與密閉空間邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ventilation and confined-space boundaries: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 通風與密閉空間邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ventilation and confined-space boundaries and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 換氣次數只描述平均空氣交換；死角、持續產氣與感測位置仍決定暴露。遊戲不提供入井許可。
steps.instructionEn: Air changes describe average exchange; dead zones, continuing generation and sensor placement govern exposure. The game grants no confined-space entry authorization.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：空間=100 m³；換氣量=500 m³/h。模型 ACH=Qair/V，代入得到 5 h⁻¹。適用邊界：均勻混合假設；換氣次數不能證明毒氣或缺氧環境安全。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Space=100 m³; ventilation=500 m³/h. Model ACH=Qair/V gives 5 h⁻¹. Applicability: Well-mixed assumption; air changes do not establish safety from toxic gas or oxygen deficiency.
steps.failure: 以鼻子是否聞到判斷 H2S 是否存在。診斷與介入：查實測風量、死角及持續產氣；密閉空間程序不能以此比值取代。
steps.failureEn: Smell is used to decide whether H2S is present. Diagnostic response: Check airflow, dead zones and continuing generation; the ratio does not replace confined-space procedures.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「通風與密閉空間邊界」的觀測點。在模型上比對送排風位置與氣體感測覆蓋，操作僅限模擬。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ventilation and confined-space boundaries. Compare supply/exhaust placement and gas-sensor coverage in simulation only. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.objective: 辨識 內襯與檢查覆蓋 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Lining and inspection coverage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 保護層連續性、接縫與基底狀況影響耐久性；遠端檢查須標出未覆蓋面積。
steps.instructionEn: Lining continuity, joints and substrate condition affect durability; remote inspection must identify unexamined area.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：已檢查管內壁面積=60 m²；目標面積=100 m²。模型 coverage=Ainspected/Atarget，代入得到 0.6 fraction。適用邊界：只表示檢查覆蓋率；未檢查區域不能假定完好。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inspected internal surface=60 m²; target area=100 m². Model coverage=Ainspected/Atarget gives 0.6 fraction. Applicability: Inspection coverage only; uninspected regions cannot be assumed sound.
steps.failure: 有影像的區域完好便推定全管完好。診斷與介入：補上遮蔽及未測區域，避免以部分影像推定全線完好。
steps.failureEn: Sound photographed areas are taken as proof that the whole pipe is sound. Diagnostic response: Add occluded/unmeasured regions rather than inferring whole-line condition from partial images.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「內襯與檢查覆蓋」的觀測點。將遠端影像、厚度測點與管段里程對齊，標示遮蔽區。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lining and inspection coverage. Align remote imagery and thickness measurements to chainage and mark occluded regions. steps.title: 處理床穿透監測：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Treatment-bed breakthrough: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 處理床穿透監測 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Treatment-bed breakthrough and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氣相吸附或反應床需追蹤床前後同成分比例；處理效率與人員暴露判定各有量測邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Track matching upstream/downstream gas species across adsorption/reactive beds; treatment efficiency and exposure have separate monitoring boundaries.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：入口 C0=100 mg/m³；出口 C=10 mg/m³。模型 B=C/C0，代入得到 0.1 fraction。適用邊界：同溫壓同成分的氣相穿透比，不是職業暴露或燃氣品質合格判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inlet C0=100 mg/m³; outlet C=10 mg/m³. Model B=C/C0 gives 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Gas breakthrough ratio for the same species and volume basis, not occupational-exposure or fuel-quality compliance.
steps.failure: 只量出口但未知道入口負荷上升。診斷與介入：同步測入口與出口氣體成分，另檢查環境暴露監測。
steps.failureEn: Only the outlet is measured, hiding rising inlet load. Diagnostic response: Measure matching inlet/outlet gases and separately check ambient-exposure monitoring.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「處理床穿透監測」的觀測點。比對床前床後同時採樣與氣體分析校正。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treatment-bed breakthrough. Compare simultaneous upstream/downstream samples and gas-analyzer calibration. steps.title: 腐蝕控制成效回訪：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 腐蝕控制成效回訪 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Follow-up of corrosion control and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以相同管段、季節條件及測點比較硫負荷、氣相與材料損失，辨識改善是否持續。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sulfide load, gas and material loss at matched reaches, seasons and points to determine whether improvement persists.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假想試片厚度減少=0.6 mm；觀察=2 yr。模型 r=Δh/t，代入得到 0.3 mm/yr。適用邊界：線性平均不保證未來速率；局部腐蝕與結構強度須另評估。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical coupon thickness loss=0.6 mm; observation=2 yr. Model r=Δh/t gives 0.3 mm/yr. Applicability: Linear average does not predict future rate; local attack and structural strength need separate assessment.
steps.failure: 短期低臭味被當作多年壽命保證。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。
steps.failureEn: Short-term odor reduction is treated as a multiyear life guarantee. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「腐蝕控制成效回訪」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.

title: 污水紫外線消毒
summary: 本課以UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍為主線，從前處理與指標菌基線、透光率與光程、照度與時間乘積、水力通道與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops uv transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope through ten connected units, beginning with pretreatment and indicator baseline, transmittance and optical path, irradiance and exposure time, hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 透光率與光程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Transmittance and optical path: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 透光率與光程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Transmittance and optical path and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: UVT 必須標明波長與光程；同一水樣的更長光程會衰減更多光。
steps.instructionEn: UVT requires wavelength and path length; longer paths through the same water attenuate more light.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：1 cm UVT=0.80；光程=3 cm。模型 T=T1^l，代入得到 0.512 fraction。適用邊界：均質吸收且忽略散射；透光率不是微生物去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: 1-cm UVT=0.80; path length=3 cm. Model T=T1^l gives 0.512 fraction. Applicability: Homogeneous absorption without scattering; transmittance is not microbial removal.
steps.failure: 把 1 cm UVT 當作整座反應器的透光率。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。
steps.failureEn: One-centimeter UVT is treated as whole-reactor transmittance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「透光率與光程」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transmittance and optical path. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.objective: 辨識 水力通道與短流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 水位、流量及擋板決定停留分布，名義體積不能辨識繞過燈區的快流。

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Effective wetted volume=0.3 m³; Q=0.02 m³/s. Model t=V/Q gives 15 s. Applicability: Nominal passage time is not minimum UV exposure time; lamp field and velocity distribution require validation.
steps.failure: 平均通過時間掩蓋最低曝光路徑。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。
steps.failureEn: Mean passage time hides minimum-exposure paths. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「水力通道與短流」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.objective: 辨識 顆粒遮蔽與水質變動 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Particle shielding and water-quality change and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 附著於顆粒內部的微生物可能受遮蔽；低濁度與高 UVT 仍需搭配顆粒及微生物證據。
steps.instructionEn: Microbes within particles can be shielded; low turbidity and high UVT still require particle and microbiological evidence.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：1 cm UVT=0.80；光程=3 cm。模型 T=T1^l，代入得到 0.512 fraction。適用邊界：均質吸收且忽略散射；透光率不是微生物去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: 1-cm UVT=0.80; path length=3 cm. Model T=T1^l gives 0.512 fraction. Applicability: Homogeneous absorption without scattering; transmittance is not microbial removal.
steps.failure: 只以濁度預測所有 UV 表現。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。

steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒遮蔽與水質變動」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particle shielding and water-quality change. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. steps.title: 生物驗證與對數降低：機制與觀察

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biodosimetry and log reduction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用指定挑戰微生物及受控條件驗證反應器，再與校正曲線相連；檢測方法決定可聲稱的降低量。
steps.instructionEn: Validate with specified challenge organisms and controlled conditions linked to a calibration curve; the analytical method limits the claimed reduction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Nin=100000；Nout=100（相同計數單位）。模型 LRV=log10(Nin/Nout)，代入得到 3 log10。適用邊界：需檢測限與回收率；未檢出不能當零。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Nin=100000; Nout=100 in matching count units. Model LRV=log10(Nin/Nout) gives 3 log10. Applicability: Requires detection limits and recovery; nondetect is not zero.
steps.failure: 未檢出結果被直接代為零而算無限降低。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。
steps.failureEn: Nondetection is entered as zero to claim infinite reduction. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「生物驗證與對數降低」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.objective: 辨識 驗證包絡與負載 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Validation envelope and loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 可用的運轉區間由經驗證的流量、UVT、燈組與感測條件組成，超出時不能靠外插宣稱達標。
steps.instructionEn: The usable envelope combines validated flow, UVT, lamp configuration and sensing; extrapolation outside it does not prove compliance.

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Effective wetted volume=0.3 m³; Q=0.02 m³/s. Model t=V/Q gives 15 s. Applicability: Nominal passage time is not minimum UV exposure time; lamp field and velocity distribution require validation.
steps.failure: 日平均流量在範圍內就忽略瞬時超量。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。
steps.failureEn: An acceptable daily mean hides instantaneous excursions. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「驗證包絡與負載」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for validation envelope and loading. Pair flow with water level and check short-circuiting using tracer or validation data. scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：流量=1000 m³/d；指標菌=100 CFU/100 mL。模型 Nday=Q×10000×C，代入得到 1e+09 CFU/d。適用邊界：只計培養法的指標菌通量；不能直接推成所有病原或感染風險。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Flow=1000 m³/d; indicator organisms=100 CFU/100 mL. Model Nday=Q×10000×C gives 1e+09 CFU/d. Applicability: Culture-based indicator-organism flux only, not all pathogens or infection risk.

title: 水處理臭氧氧化
summary: 本課以臭氧氣液傳質、需求、反應與副產物為主線，從處理目的與前驅物、原料氣與乾燥邊界、產生、注入與尾氣、需求與殘留衰減進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops ozone gas-liquid transfer, demand, reaction and byproducts through ten connected units, beginning with treatment goals and precursors, feed-gas conditioning boundary, generation, injection and off-gas, demand and residual decay. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 處理目的與前驅物：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Treatment goals and precursors: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 處理目的與前驅物 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Treatment goals and precursors and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先區分消毒、色味或特定化合物氧化目標；不同水質的臭氧需求與副產物路徑不同。
steps.instructionEn: Separate disinfection, color/odor and target-compound oxidation goals; ozone demand and byproduct pathways depend on water quality.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
steps.failure: 只以去色當所有污染物已去除。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。
steps.failureEn: Decolorization is used to claim removal of all contaminants. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「處理目的與前驅物」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treatment goals and precursors. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
